**JOB PURPOSE:** 




 Senior role within the Real Estate Finance team with the purpose of originating and executing Real Estate Finance transactions for CIB clients of the Bank and to support the real estate transactions of wider REF team globally. Develop strategic relationships with banks and real estate professionals to identify REF opportunities that are aligned to FAB’s client and credit appetite. Work closely with the Corporate and Financial Institutions coverage teams and product teams of FAB.
 



 To act as a centre of excellence for Real Estate financing in the Bank. To ensure an environment and culture of origination and creative thinking and solutions are fostered at all times
 



 Work closely with all departments of the Bank to ensure deal opportunities are activated and communication is harmonised.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:** 




 The role encompasses, enhancing the bank's capabilities in the real estate finance covering all forms of RE finance structures in addition to identifying opportunities for equity origination and deal placement. This will involve:
 


* Meeting clients/sponsors.
* Originating, structuring and executing new deals along with the coverage \& credit team.
* Thoroughly review the existing CRE loan book and identify opportunities to secure existing loans business through a combination of refinance and restructuring.
* Build a platform for growth to support new business initiatives across the FAB footprint.
* Working with other market leaders on transactions and further enhancing FAB’s international profile.
* Taking the lead in pricing discussions with clients.
* Working on internal reporting, MIS requirements and support the Head of REF in strategic initiatives.
* Help contribute to the GCF budget in addition to being alive to opportunities in our GM, Agency \& DCM businesses.
* The person will be responsible for buildingassets and achieving budget via P\&L both on a shadow income (hedging income) perspective for deals bookedand a hard cash basis for underwriting skim, structuring \& participation fees.



**Budgets and Plans:** 



* Contribute to the preparation of the sub\-departmental budget and monitor the section’s cost ratio and make the Head of Real Estate Finance aware of performance gaps with suggestions to rectify and improve performance.



  





**Internal Collaboration:** 



* Maintain strong internal relations and collaborate with Coverage partners (IBG, FIG, Corporate Banking, New Client Acquisition) in order to maximise product development \& revenue generation opportunities.
* Develop service level targets and manage the coordination of the section with other departments to meet service expectations.



  





**Policies, Systems, Processes, \& Procedures:** 



* Implement departmental policies, systems, and procedure so that all relevant procedural/ legislative requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality and cost\-effective service.



  





**MIS and Reports:** 




 Supervise and provide inputs in the preparation of timely and accurate sub\-departmental statements and reports (esp. the Underwriting \& Sales Report) to meet FAB’s and departmental requirements, policies, and standards.
 



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE:** 




**Knowledge \& Experience:** 



* Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or a related discipline.
* 10\+ years of experience in managing and facilitating real estate loans business in a banking environment.
* In\-depth knowledge of the Real Estate sector, and FAB’s products and business strategies.
* Deep understanding and working knowledge of international real estate debt markets and syndicated loan \& debt capital market.



**Skills:** 



* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to understand financing structures based on the current \& expected market conditions.
* Ability to multi\-task with strong credit, structuring and LMA documentation, expertise required.
* Strong negotiating skills and ability to exercise good judgment which balances needs of client, investors and FAB.
* Solid understanding of accounting and financial statements.
* Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities.
* Ability to build and develop strategic relationships.

data.jd_text:
Project Director – High Rise Residential Construction \| Mumbai
 



 We are currently working on a confidential leadership mandate with one of India’s leading real estate developers for a landmark luxury high\-rise residential development in Mumbai. Mandatory experience in delivering 300m\+ residential tower projects is required for this role. Candidates must have prior experience leading execution of 80\+ floor high\-rise residential developments from commencement through completion.
 



 The organization is looking to appoint an experienced Project Director to lead the complete end\-to\-end execution of a large\-scale iconic residential tower project from commencement through final delivery.
 



 This role requires a seasoned construction leader with strong technical expertise, leadership capability, and a proven track record in delivering complex high\-rise developments globally or within India.
 



 Job Purpose:
 



 The Project Director will lead the overall execution strategy, planning, design coordination, construction management, budgeting, contracts, procurement, stakeholder management, quality control, safety, and final delivery of the project. The role demands close coordination across multidisciplinary teams and leadership stakeholders while ensuring delivery within timelines, quality standards, and commercial objectives.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 



 • Define the overall project strategy, execution roadmap, and construction schedules in coordination with leadership and consultants
 



 • Lead multidisciplinary teams across design, engineering, procurement, construction, commercial, contracts, and quality functions
 



 • Oversee advanced engineering coordination between structural, MEP, façade, interiors, and vertical transportation consultants
 



 • Drive value engineering, constructability reviews, and technical optimization during design development stages
 



 • Lead construction execution for high\-rise structures including deep foundations, core \& shell systems, façade systems, luxury interiors, and premium finishing packages
 



 • Ensure strict compliance with project timelines, quality benchmarks, EHS standards, statutory regulations, and international construction standards
 



 • Monitor project progress through regular reviews, reporting systems, and construction tracking mechanisms
 



 • Manage project budgets, cashflows, cost controls, escalations, and commercial performance
 



 • Oversee tendering, bid evaluations, procurement strategy, contractor management, claims management, and contract administration for major packages including civil, MEP, façade, and interiors
 



 • Work closely with internal leadership teams, consultants, architects, PMCs, contractors, sales teams, and regulatory authorities
 



 • Identify project risks proactively and implement mitigation strategies across technical, commercial, and operational aspects
 



 • Build and lead high\-performing project management teams while driving accountability and execution excellence
 



 • Implement modern construction technologies, BIM\-enabled coordination, digital monitoring tools, and international best practices
 



 Experience Requirements:
 



 • Graduate in Civil Engineering is mandatory; M.Tech / MBA in Project Management preferred
 



 • 20–25\+ years of experience in large\-scale building construction projects
 



 • Mandatory experience delivering 300m\+ residential tower developments
 



 • Must have led execution of 80\+ floor high\-rise residential or mixed\-use projects from start to completion
 



 • Strong expertise in structural systems, façade engineering, MEP coordination, vertical transportation systems, and premium residential construction
 



 • Prior GCC / international high\-rise construction exposure will be considered an advantage
 



 • Experience working with reputed developers, PMCs, EPC firms, or international contracting organizations preferred
 



 • Strong understanding of modern construction technologies, BIM systems, project controls, cost management, safety systems, and stakeholder management required
 



 Key Skills \& Competencies:
 



 • Strategic project planning and execution
 



 • Leadership and multidisciplinary team management
 



 • Technical coordination and construction management
 



 • Contractual and commercial management
 



 • Risk mitigation and quality systems implementation
 



 • Stakeholder engagement and decision\-making capability
 



 • Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
 



 • Ability to manage large\-scale complex developments under demanding timelines
 



 This is a rare opportunity to lead one of India’s most ambitious skyline\-defining residential developments currently under execution.
 



 For a confidential discussion, please connect directly:
 



 📩 kara.sharma@mrgglobal.com
 



 📞 \+91 8446117482

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 We are a leading international law and professional services firm providing legal, corporate and fiduciary services to global corporations, financial institutions, capital market participants and investment fund managers. With a global presence spanning the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we advise on the laws of Bermuda, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Guernsey, Ireland and Jersey.
   

  

 We treat everyone as the intelligent professional they are. Our approach is to trust and empower our people to deliver consistently, and enable them to succeed. Diversity is our secret weapon – it’s the sheer breadth of Walkers people that makes us who we are – gathered from across the globe and fluent in languages, jurisdictions and cultures that help us to mirror our clients and keep our own thinking in tune with the world in which we operate.
   

  

**Overview Of Role**
 This role will ideally be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office.
   

  

 We are keen to hear from qualified candidates in London who are open to relocating to Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced compliance professional with a background in the legal or professional services sector to join a team dealing with conflicts of interest and client confidentiality matters.
   

  

 Reporting to our Director of Conflicts and joining the OGC team, the successful candidate will assist with the development of a specialised team of conflicts professionals responsible for analysing, advising on and resolving legal and commercial conflicts of interest, information barriers and share dealing requests. This is to ensure we comply with all applicable regulations, professional rules of conduct, contractual terms related to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and protect client relationships and our reputation.
   

  

 Our conflicts analysts assist with the resolution of complex conflicts issues, deal with sensitive confidential matters, and carry out conflict checks associated with share dealing requests and lateral hires into the business.
   

  

 The Senior Conflicts Manager will work closely with the Director of Conflicts on the ongoing development of our policies, controls and processes as they relate to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, information barriers, share dealing and Market Abuse Regulations. This will include optimising our use of tech/automation (including
 *Intapp* 
 ), standardising and simplifying our policies and processes across the Walkers group, and building an optimal team shape that provides agility, efficiency, consistency and excellent service to the business and our clients.
   

  

**Duties, Responsibilities \& Person Specification**
* Day\-to\-day management of conflicts advisors within the relevant time zone (including leading the recruitment of additional conflicts advisors).
* Act as a point of escalation for the team and the business on all legal and commercial conflicts issues, analysing and resolving issues in accordance with applicable regulations, professional rules and Walkers own policy and procedures.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across Walkers globally, acting as a point of contact in relation to all conflicts and client confidentiality queries and leading communications across the business in this area.
* Together with other senior team members, lead on internal training as it relates to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, share dealing and insider lists.
* Identify any weaknesses or areas for potential improvement in our existing client onboarding system (Intapp Intake) and, working with the Director of Conflicts and the Compliance Business Systems team, recommend enhancements that streamline/simplify processes for team and the business, and/or strengthen our controls.
* Working with the Director of Conflicts and key stakeholders from across the business, develop and deliver a phased programme of work that: (i) rapidly enhances our conflicts offering/service delivery to the business (including through improved time zone coverage/capacity, responsiveness, efficiency and expertise); (ii) enables us to provide a fully centralised conflict checking/analysis function within the next two years.
* Support the Director of Conflicts in driving quality, consistency, service excellence, efficiency, proactivity and adaptability across the Conflicts team.
* Assist the Director of Conflicts in developing and leading people initiatives within the Conflicts team to drive development of expertise and skills, attraction and retention, and fostering a high\-performing, collaborative and open team culture.
* Input into regular reporting to senior management and/or other stakeholders as required.
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives which impact or relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality.
* Keep abreast with developments in regulation, technology and the market which are relevant to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, market abuse/insider trading, and information barriers.


**Education, Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelors degree in law, business, finance or another relevant field.
* Experience in a compliance or in\-house legal role in an international law firm or professional services environment.
* Compliance expert with deep technical and practical knowledge of legal conflicts of interest, commercial conflicts and client confidentiality, with some knowledge of Market Abuse Regs.
* Familiarity with Intapp Intake.
* Experience of policy work.
* Experience of people management, including supervision/management of large teams and experience devising and driving people initiatives (including around recruitment and development).
* Proven track record of delivering change and process improvements.
* Experience working in an offshore environment or with offshore structures would be helpful but not required
* Strategic: ability to work in pursuit of a clear strategic direction, align the teams priorities with those of the wider OGC team and the firm, and proactively identify improvements.
* Leadership: ability to lead and inspire the team, drive collaboration and foster a high\-performing team culture.
* Technical: deep knowledge of relevant regulations and professional rules as they relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and an ability to apply these in practice.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills: solutions\-orientated with the ability to interpret complex fact patterns to reach decisions or develop clear recommendations.
* Quality: strong attention to detail and produces high quality work product.
* Judgement: confident taking decisions, with sound judgement of when to escalate issues or seek further opinions.
* Adaptable: willingness to embrace change and uncertainty and manage competing demands in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment; willing to constructively challenge the status quo.
* Communication: strong verbal and written communication skills, ensuring communications are properly targeted, persuasive, accurate and accessible.
* Emotional intelligence: ability to empathise, understand, and manage emotions effectively, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment.
* Collaborative: builds strong and effective relationships with stakeholders and peers; works collaboratively with colleagues across the business. A "one\-team" ethos.
* Commercial: sound, commercially driven decision\-making. A relentless focus on service excellence.
* Familiarity with Intapp.


**Other**
* Walkers is a global business and this role may therefore require audio or video conferencing outside of normal business hours.
* This role will be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office. However, our agile working policy does allow some home working each week.

 Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 2\. 高并发与低延迟架构支持
 



 \- 支撑高频交易与极端行情流量洪峰（行情波动、插针行情、黑天鹅事件等）

 \- 负责全球多机房、多地域云资源架构设计与统一管理（AWS / GCP / 阿里云等）
 



 \- 推动全球节点部署（亚太、欧美等）与跨境网络优化
 



 \- 优化云资源成本结构与资源利用率
 



 4\. 运维体系与自动化建设（SRE/DevOps）
 



 \- 建设标准化SRE体系，包括监控、告警、发布、变更、回滚机制
 



 \- 推动全链路自动化运维（CI/CD、自动扩缩容、自动故障自愈）
 



 \- 建设统一监控体系（Metrics/Logs/Tracing）与AIOps能力
 



 5\. 安全与风控支撑
 



 \- 建立基础设施安全体系（权限管理、访问控制、漏洞管理、DDoS防护）
 



 \- 配合安全团队构建交易安全与资金安全防护体系
 



 \- 支撑风控系统稳定运行（异常交易监控、风险引擎稳定性保障）
 



 6\. 重大故障与应急管理
 



 \- 负责重大线上事故的应急响应、根因分析（RCA）及复盘机制

Müller's Solutions is seeking an experienced and results\-driven

 Serve as the main escalation point and decision\-maker for delivery\-related issues, ensuring that:

 Provide strong leadership to the delivery teams, which include:

* Business analysts, supporting requirement gathering, documentation, and communication between business and technical teams

 Lead delivery governance and uphold standards, ensuring:

* Controlled release processes that minimize risk, ensure quality, and provide clear documentation

 Ensure quality and accountability across delivery, including:

* Supporting issue resolution and performance improvement initiatives to enhance service quality and customer satisfaction


 Act as a trusted point of contact for stakeholders, capable of:
   

  

* Representing technical and functional decisions clearly and effectively, bridging communication between business and IT teams
* Managing expectations and resolving conflicts diplomatically to maintain positive relationships and project momentum
* Standing behind delivery teams with confidence, advocating for resources, and providing guidance to overcome challenges


 Support continuous improvement of service delivery, including:
   

  

* Identifying inefficiencies and bottlenecks through regular process reviews and feedback collection
* Driving optimisation of processes and workflows to increase efficiency, reduce costs, and improve user experience
* Promoting effective use of ServiceNow capabilities by encouraging adoption of new features, best practices, and ongoing training


**Requirements**

* Cross\-functional teams


**Strong knowledge of:**

* Management of SLAs and KPIs
* Release and change management procedures


**Ability to:**
* Assertively participate in stakeholder discussions and justify delivery decisions

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* ITIL Foundation or higher certification

* Experience working with Agile methodologies and project management tools
* Familiarity with automation and workflow optimization within the ServiceNow platform

**About IC Markets** 




 IC Markets Global is one of the most renowned Forex CFD provider, offering trading solutions for active day traders and scalpers as well as traders that are new to the forex market. IC Markets Global offers its clients cutting edge trading platforms, low latency connectivity and superior liquidity.
 



 IC Markets Global is revolutionizing online forex trading. Traders are now able to gain access to pricing previously only available to investment banks and high net worth individuals.
 



 Our management team have significant experience in the Forex, CFD and Equity markets in Asia, Europe and North America. It is this experience that has enabled us to select the best possible technology solutions and hand pick some of the best pricing providers available in the market.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are seeking an experienced Technical Delivery Manager to lead the end\-to\-end delivery of complex, high\-impact programmes across multiple engineering teams. This senior role is the critical connective layer between engineering, product, architecture, and leadership. responsible for resolving cross\-team dependencies, driving delivery of intricate technical projects, and ensuring predictable, high\-quality outcomes at scale. The ideal candidate brings deep technical fluency combined with exceptional programme management skills, and thrives in navigating ambiguity across distributed, multi\-disciplinary teams within a regulated fintech environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Cross\-Team Dependency \& Complex Delivery Management** 



* Own and drive resolution of cross\-team technical dependencies across 8–12\+ engineering squads
* Establish and maintain programme\-level dependency maps, risk registers, and escalation paths
* Lead planning and execution of complex, multi\-team deliveries spanning months or multiple quarters
* Identify inter\-team blockers early and orchestrate timely resolution with engineering leads and architects
* Coordinate integration milestones, shared API contracts, and platform\-level dependencies across squads



  





**Delivery \& Release Governance** 



* Define and enforce delivery governance frameworks for large\-scale technical programmes
* Ensure production readiness through structured release checkpoints, go/no\-go criteria, and sign\-off processes
* Oversee end\-to\-end release management across parallel workstreams, coordinating across QA, DevOps, and Platform teams
* Monitor programme health, critical path, and execution risks; escalate proactively to leadership
* Drive standardization of release and deployment governance across the engineering organization



  





**Technical Programme Leadership** 



* Partner with Engineering Leads, Principal Engineers, and Architects to translate technical strategy into actionable delivery plans
* Lead structured programme ceremonies: dependency syncs, architecture reviews, cross\-team planning, and programme\-level retrospectives
* Maintain and evolve Agile and hybrid delivery frameworks tailored to programme complexity and team maturity
* Drive PI Planning and large\-scale increment coordination across product and platform squads



  





**Stakeholder \& Executive Engagement** 



* Serve as the primary delivery interface for senior stakeholders, CTO, and executive leadership on complex programmes
* Produce clear, data\-driven programme status reports, risk dashboards, and delivery forecasts for leadership review
* Translate complex technical interdependencies into business\-level impact narratives for non\-technical audiences
* Proactively manage expectations, surface trade\-offs, and recommend delivery options under constraint.



  





**Tooling \& Delivery Intelligence** 



* Own and evolve programme\-level Jira structures including epics hierarchies, dependency links, cross\-project boards, and automation
* Drive delivery intelligence through advanced metrics: cycle time, lead time, flow efficiency, dependency resolution SLAs.
* Build and maintain executive\-level dashboards that surface programme health, risk, and delivery confidence
* Ensure tooling practices support audit readiness and compliance requirements in a regulated financial services environment



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* 10\+ years in Technical Delivery Management, Programme Management, or Engineering Leadership roles
* Proven track record delivering complex, multi\-team technical programmes in a regulated or high\-stakes environment
* Deep expertise in cross\-team dependency management across large engineering organizations (8\+ teams)
* Strong technical fluency; ability to engage credibly with engineers, architects, and platform teams on technical trade\-offs
* Extensive experience with Agile at scale frameworks and hybrid delivery models
* Advanced Jira administration, programme\-level workflow design, and delivery metrics expertise
* Proven experience driving complex release governance across distributed, parallel workstreams
* Experience working in fintech, trading platforms, or high\-frequency, regulated product environments strongly preferred
* Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving clarity in a fast\-paced, high\-complexity environment

**Job Purpose**
* The Plant Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, and profitable operations. The role delivers manufacturing excellence aligned with business strategy, approved budgets, and customer requirements, while ensuring compliance with UAE regulatory authorities and international standards.
* The position drives performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability, champions continuous improvement and advanced manufacturing practices, and builds a high performing, future ready leadership team
* The Plant Director actively champions the adoption of modern manufacturing technologies, operational best practices, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, reliability, and competitiveness.
* The role works closely with cross‑ functional teams to ensure seamless execution, transparent communication, and sustained long‑ term value creation for the business.


**Job Dimensions**
* Number of Staff Supervised: Direct Reports: 8, Total: 340
* Reports to: Manufacturing Operations Director
* Direct Reports: Business Unit Managers, Maintenance Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Purchase Manager, Production Engineering Manager, Contracts Manager and Finance Manager
* Functional reports: IT Lead, Regional HR Manager, HSE Manager, Quality Manager


**Key Accountabilities**
 Strategy \& Operations
   

  

* Develop and execute the manufacturing and operations strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Deliver production targets with consistent On Time In Full (OTIF) performance and right first time quality.
* Set and deliver aggressive yet achievable facility goals aligned to long term company strategy.
* Ensure effective performance management and accountability across the Operations leadership team.
* Act as the primary interface with local regulatory authorities (e.g. JAFZA, DCD, Trakhees/EHS).


 Operational Excellence \& Efficiency
   

  

* Drive continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, and productivity enhancement initiatives.
* Optimise manufacturing processes, capacity, and asset utilisation in line with the Medium Term Plan.
* Implement flexible workforce models aligned with SOPs and demand variation.


 Quality \& HSE
   

  

* Ensure all products meet or exceed defined quality, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Embed a strong quality culture and operational discipline across the plant.
* Ensure full compliance with Environmental, Health \& Safety standards


 Financial Performance
   

  

* Manage site profitability, cost control, and budget adherence.
* Lead S\&OP execution to balance demand, capacity, revenue, and customer commitments.
* Optimise inventory levels and drive inventory reduction initiatives.
* Drive material and conversion cost reductions in collaboration with Procurement and Supply Chain


 People \& Leadership
   

  

* Build, develop, and lead a high performing management team.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building across functions.
* Foster a collaborative, performance driven, and values based culture.


 Customer Focus \& Business Excellence
   

  

* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through delivery, quality, and responsiveness.
* Promote cross functional collaboration across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Projects, and Sales.
* Champion new technologies, digitalisation, and best in class manufacturing practices.


 New Product Introduction
   

  

* Work closely with Engg, Manufacturing systems manager, supply chain and purchasing on new product industrialisation in a timely manner


 KPIs
   

  

* Safety performance and regulatory compliance
* OTIF delivery
* Budget vs. Actual
* Profitability and MPV
* Scrap, rework, and customer complaints
* Inventory turns and cost recovery
* Leadership capability and succession readiness

The role leads a multi disciplinary operations organisation, overseeing manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, maintenance, and HSE, within a competitive, cost sensitive, and delivery driven market.
   

  

 Reporting to the Manufacturing Operations Director, the role works in close collaboration with regional Sales, Projects, Engineering, Procurement, and corporate functions to align plant capability with customer demand, strategic growth plans, and localisation requirements. The position interfaces regularly with local regulatory and governing bodies in Dubai to ensure compliance, certification, and operational continuity, while balancing operational excellence, people development, and long term business sustainability

data.jd_text:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. The Middle East markets (UAE and Kuwait) are one of our most dynamic and competitive markets. Functions include commercial, operations, and marketing, and teams in the Middle East partner closely with global functions such as product, technology, and consumer to deliver results for our customers.
   

  

 This role sits within Operations and leads all things Rider Experience. A large and impactful scope that includes Rider community management, Rider communications, several aspects of Rider Performance, Rider Support, and Rider Onboarding. The role entails building, improving, and implementing processes across the areas above, tracking and managing efficiency and effectiveness of how we are performing across a variety of metrics, and finally ensuring that we are able to deliver excellent support to riders across the region.
   

  

**The Role**
 Operating at scale in a hyper\-competitive, hyper\-growth environment is no easy feat. As such, you'll be faced with some of the most exciting problems across the food tech space. Reporting to the Director of Operations, Middle East, you’ll have a key role in ensuring the success of the logistics network in our Middle East markets. This centers around ensuring that we always have a fleet of highly engaged, highly satisfied, and highly performing riders on our network. Working with stakeholders within Ops to find the right approach through levers like communications, education modules, and rider events. This role is regional, and will be required to build world\-class frameworks and systems that are both effective and scalable. The objective is straightforward: build the best systems to ensure riders are able to deliver the best experience for our customers and merchants.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with other members of the Middle East rider operations teams, as well as wider teams within HQ Ops, Product, and Tech to ensure the best possible outcomes for our riders, restaurants, and customers.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Here’s what your day\-to\-day might look like:
   

  

* Managing a large team that owns and runs several processes across the scope of the team
* Building effective, scalable, and efficient frameworks and systems that can be centralized to manage and track several key metrics across our network
* Make recommendations on how to allocate our resources to ensure the best possible outcomes, for instance, managing rider churn to optimal levels to ensure best\-in\-class service levels
* Ensuring the quality and engagement of riders newly onboarded on our network is conducive to our strategy of having best\-in\-class service levels
* Track our key metrics, look for unusual trends in our data, and uncover root causes to ensure that we preserve the health of the network.
* Work alongside other members of the Middle East Rider Operations team to ensure that we operate to budget
* Provide regular, relevant, concise updates on rider experience to senior business stakeholders.


**What You'll Need To Thrive**
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
   

  

* A high standard of university\-level education
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, consulting, banking, engineering, or a high\-growth start\-up
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – experience solving tough, complex problems
* An ownership mindset that means you know what is happening in your area of responsibility
* Experience managing a multi\-functional team
* Experience building scalable processes, tools, and structured change methodologies, and therefore enjoying working in a process\-driven environment
* Strong analytical mindset and comfortable with large data sets
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Comfortable handling multiple workstreams at the same time, working both individually and as part of a team


**Why Join Us?**
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real\-world problems in a three\-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
   

  

 We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders, And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here, You Can Expect To
   

  

**🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale** 
 Work on a complex, always\-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
   

  

 🌱
 **See your impact, fast** 
 Ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low\-hierarchy, high\-ownership
   

  

 environment.
   

  

**🧠Grow through challenge and ownership** 
 Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
   

  

**🌎A culture built for builders** 
 High standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.
   

  

 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3\-4 stages. Find more about how we hire
 **here.**
**Our Global Structure**
 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
 At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
   

  

 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio\-economic background, religion, or belief.
   

  

 If you have a disability or long\-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
   

  

 If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast\-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

* Prepare all customer meetings with presentation and collecting required information internally.
* Maintain a list of issues / gaps and follow\-up internally and provide summary to the customer in the meetings and on request.
* Maintain all presentations, meeting minutes and risk, issues, action, and dependencies (RAID) tracker in a central repository.

* Managed Detection Response.
* Managed Vulnerability.
* Managed Security Controls (FW, Proxy, EDR, PAM).
* Digital Risk Protection.
* Digital Forensics and Incident Response.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* UAE Nationals are encouraged to apply.
* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, a related degree, or relevant industry experience; Expert skills in IT service delivery.
* Minimum 5 years of experience as a Service Delivery Manager.
* Solid background in IT service management, with expertise in cybersecurity and understanding of management systems including ISMS, BCMS, QMS.
* ITIL accreditation (or equivalent relevant experience).
* Expert skills in usage of Office 365, ITSM Systems.
* Demonstrable knowledge and understanding of information security technologies, concepts and standards.
* Excellent organizational skills, ability to influence and manage customer expectations.
* Customer and team\-focused attitude.
* Excellent communication, presentation and training skills.
* Being able to understand complex business processes and activities.
* Flexible work approach, based on the job requirements.
* Active listener.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate well with others and reconcile differences among resources/departments.


**Benefits**

* Career progression and growth through challenging projects and work.
* Employee engagement and wellness campaigns activities throughout the year.
* Excellent learning and development opportunities.
* Annual flights tickets.
* Inclusive and diverse working environment.
* Flexible/Hybrid working environment.
* Open door policy.


**About Us**
 Help AG is the cybersecurity arm of e\& enterprise (formerly Etisalat Digital) and provides leading enterprise businesses across the Middle East with strategic consultancy combined with tailored information security solutions and services that address their diverse requirements, enabling them to evolve securely with a competitive edge.
   

  

 Present in the Middle East since 2004, Help AG was strategically acquired by e\& (formerly Etisalat Group) in 2020, hence creating a cybersecurity and digital transformation powerhouse in the region.
   

  

 Help AG has firmly established itself as the region's trusted IT security advisor by remaining vendor\-agnostic, trustworthy, independent, and maintaining its focus on all aspects of cybersecurity. With best of breed technologies from industry\-leading vendor partners, expertly qualified service delivery teams and a state\-of\-the\-art consulting practice, Help AG delivers unmatched value to its customers by strengthening their cyber defenses and safeguarding their business.

data.raw_snippet:
**Deliveroo: A DoorDash Company:** 
 Deliveroo’s mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders. Following our successful 2025 merger with DoorDash, we have solidified our position as the global leader
data.jd_text:
**Deliveroo: A DoorDash Company:** 
 Deliveroo’s mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders. Following our successful 2025 merger with DoorDash, we have solidified our position as the global leader in local commerce. This partnership has expanded our footprint to over 45 markets and gives us access to industry\-leading technology and resources. It is a defining moment for our New Verticals business, specifically our 1P delivery\-only sites, Editions and HOP. We are no longer just a delivery app; we are building the infrastructure for the future of instant retail. There has never been a more exciting time to join the 'Roo family' as we integrate with the DoorDash ecosystem to redefine what is possible in the UAE and beyond.
   

  

**New Verticals \& Site Operations:** 
 As part of the DoorDash group, our New Verticals team is the primary global engine for testing and scaling the next generation of first party (1P) retail and automated logistics. We don't just facilitate orders; we own the sites that make them happen. While others act as simple aggregators, we own the infrastructure and the operations to ensure a premium, hyper\-fast experience.
   

  

* Deliveroo Editions: The world's first delivery\-only kitchens. We provide the specialised infrastructure and operational expertise that allow our restaurant partners to scale instantly.
* Deliveroo HOP: Our 1P speedy grocery service. We own the inventory, the technology, and the end\-to\-end fulfilment process to deliver groceries in as little as 15 minutes.


**The Role:** 
 The Regional Manager oversees the end\-to\-end operations of our proprietary, 1P delivery\-only sites across the UAE, spanning both our restaurant (Editions) and retail (HOP) verticals. This is a high\-impact leadership role that balances "boots\-on\-the\-ground" operational rigour with mid\-to\-long\-term strategic decision\-making. As the primary owner of these sites, you will be responsible for all of 1P success: Uncompromised safety, perfect stock integrity, and lightning\-fast throughput.
   

  

**Operational Leadership \& Excellence**
 You will drive the business forward by optimising productivity, achieving site personnel cost targets, and minimising wastage/shrinkage. You must be a "Total Ownership" leader; comfortable working strategically to enhance our operating model within the global DoorDash ecosystem while fostering a positive, collaborative, and high\-performance culture for all site colleagues. Below are the 3 key areas this role is expected to manage:
   

  

* Site Governance: Set the "drumbeat" for the region by driving KPIs and supervising compliance with Standard Operating Procedures through impactful coaching.
* Site Presence: Maintain a constant physical presence at sites to ensure a "founder’s mindset" regarding cleanliness, efficiency, and quality.
* Safety \& Compliance: Act as the lead for regional regulatory relationships, ensuring 100% compliance with Dubai Municipality (DM), ADAFSA, etc.


**Financial \& Data Stewardship**
* P\&L Management: Manage the operational lines of the P\&L, tightly controlling labor and OpEx while minimising all forms of wastage/shrinkage.
* WBR/MBR Reporting: Host and participate in Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews. You will produce high\-quality, data\-driven written inputs that articulate regional performance and clear bridges with action plans.


**People \& Strategy**
* Team Development: Recruit, onboard, and mentor a high\-performing Area Manager team, managing the full organisational life cycle from talent development to HR/ER cases.
* Stakeholder Management: Own and champion relationships with host brand partners, site owners, and senior leadership within the wider DoorDash/Deliveroo business.
* Innovation: Lead projects and pilots aimed at testing the next generation of 1P retail and automated logistics.


**Requirements**
* Industry Leadership: Minimum of 3–4 years of F\&B, FMCG, or Grocery experience, with a proven track record in Area or Regional Management.
* Operational Ownership: While direct experience in a 1P environment is a significant advantage, it is essential you demonstrate a "Total Ownership" mindset. This means you are comfortable being the final point of accountability for site standards, stock accuracy, and the seamless hand\-off from inbound receiving to last\-mile dispatch.
* Rigorous Cost Control: Expert at managing and influencing the P\&L with a focus on operational expenditure. You possess the ability to identify inefficiencies and manage labor\-to\-order ratios effectively.
* Strong Writing \& Communication: Ability to craft concise, insightful narratives for WBR and MBR reports, translating raw data into "the why" and "the how" for senior leadership.
* Analytical \& Tech\-Savvy: Data\-driven decision\-maker with a high comfort level in numbers.
* Adaptability \& Autonomy: The grit to define how your role is best achieved in a fast\-paced, evolving environment with high levels of autonomy.
* People Leadership: Excellent ability to influence senior stakeholders while motivating a multi\-national, diverse site\-level workforce.
* Project Management: Capability to lead complex, cross\-functional projects from conception to completion.


**UAE Regulatory Knowledge (Preferred):** 
 Familiarity with navigating inspections and compliance requirements for DM, ADAFSA, and Civil Defence.

**Who are we?**
**When you think of food delivery in the MENA region, we’d be pretty surprised if talabat didn’t pop into your mind first! Since delivering our first order in Kuwait in 2004, we’ve grown quite a lot over the past 17 years.**
**Today, we deliver hundreds of millions of food orders, grocery items and other products per year, to our customers in nine countries throughout the region with more than 3,000\+ employees! Our food delivery business works with over 27,000 brands and almost 50,000 branches, while our q\-commerce concept, talabat mart, now delivers groceries to customers in Bahrain, Egypt, Jordan, Kuwait, Oman Qatar, and the UAE in 30 minutes or less!**
**Our philosophy is to make sure we do what is right for our ecosystem \- our customers, our partners, our people, our riders, and the communities in which we operate. Our \#techforgood program allows our customers a safe and convenient way to contribute to important causes in their community through donating to local and international charities directly on talabat with a focus on food insecurity in the region. Since its inception in 2020, we have facilitated the donation of well over 1 million meals to those in need, as well as donated over $1\.5 million to charity with the help of our partners and customers. talabat is part of Delivery Hero, the global leader in online food delivery and q\-commerce.**
**As Talabat continues to grow and keep ahead of the curve we have launched our very own end\-end grocery service across the MENA region: tMart**

**Introduction To Role**
 The International region is AstraZeneca’s largest, most diverse and fastest\-growing region, representing around one\-third of total company revenue. Spanning more than 90 countries across five continents, it covers over 70% of the world’s population. International is not “Rest of World” — it is “Most of World” — and with that scale comes a profound responsibility to patients, as the burden of non\-communicable disease and mortality is disproportionately high across our markets. International is a critical growth engine for AstraZeneca, delivering double\-digit growth across all therapy areas and playing a central role in the company’s future success. We operate in a complex, rapidly evolving environment — and we are doubling down on growth and pipeline delivery to make Ambition 2030 a reality in International. At the heart of this is how we use AI, digital and data to transform our company, accelerate our science and maximize our impact for patients.
 *Ready to influence how a major global business runs its future?*
 We are looking for a dynamic individual to fulfil the role of
 **Senior Director, Digital \& AI for Analytics and Process Transformation, International** 
 . The successful candidate will be accountable for re\-wiring critical process to simplify and accelerate through AI and automation, starting with key performance analytics and annual business cycle processes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be capable of navigating a senior leadership environment, securing progress with minimal direction, and showcasing proactive initiative. Moreover, Senior Director Digital \& AI for Analytics and Process Transformation will bring domain expertise in Data, Insight and Analytics including performance analytics, data strategy, and data visualization with a strong understanding of business fundamentals.
   

  

 Excellent cross functional leadership experience as well as an extensive knowledge of drug development and commercialization is crucial. Demonstrably strong skills in the areas of strategic thinking, decision making, communication, enterprise leadership, problem solving, influence without authority.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
 Digital \& AI for
 **Analytics and Process Transformation**
* Automation and Process redesign: Identify and automate high\-friction workflows, applying AI automation to remove bottlenecks, reduce cycle times and manual effort while improving quality and compliance
* Annual business cycle transformation: Embed AI to simplify and automate planning, forecasting, and performance reviews
* Analytics modernization: Rewire key performance analytics (commercial, medical, market access) with standardized datasets, highly visual dashboards, and AI\-enabled automation and analytics to accelerate decision\-making, acting as voice into global GIBEX, EAI, AXIAL programs
* AI \& digital fluency: Define and execute the upskilling agenda for International — building AI literacy, data fluency, and digital ways\-of\-working across functions
* Enterprise alignment: Partner with Global GIBEX, EAI, AXIAL and other enterprise programs to ensure International priorities are represented, while partnering to adapt global capabilities to local market realities


**Essential Skills / Experience**
* Subject\-matter expertise in Sales and Marketing, AI, Digital and Innovation
* Experience in Data, Insight and Analytics including Forecasting and Performance Analytics
* Understanding of the dynamic external environment including new innovative digital technology
* Highly developed communication and influencing abilities across organizational teams and levels in a large and matrixed operating environment
* Ability to express sophisticated ideas in a clear and compelling way to multiple external and internal partner groups
* Proven business partnering skills across multiple stakeholder groups
* Proven project management skills in matrix organizations
* An excellent communicator; ability to simplify complex messages into clear, visual stories and messages for executive presentations
* Experience of working with Senior Management Teams with good understanding of decision\-making dynamics
* Evidence of the ability to pull together diverse teams over whom they have no line management responsibility
* Experience of successful influencing cross functionally, cross\-culturally and cross\-TA
* Evidence of strong independence and innovative seeker of strategic solutions; a strongly conceptual thinker
* Curiosity and capability to understand and support business need from different business areas
* Pragmatism and can\-do attitude


*AstraZeneca offers the chance to shape the future of healthcare at scale, combining scientific strength with real\-world impact across diverse markets; work happens in an open, collaborative community where people learn from each other, stretch beyond their comfort zone and see a clear link between their efforts and better outcomes for patients, supported by leaders who value curiosity, sustainability and continuous development. If this role sparks your ambition to transform how data, AI and digital power impact for patients across the world, apply now to join the journey!*

data.jd_text:
This role is critical to ensuring the Director stays organized, informed, and efficient across all business priorities.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, and proactive—capable of managing time independently and staying focused in a fast\-paced environment. You should have a proven track record supporting executives or business leaders, with strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to resolve issues quickly with minimal supervision.
 



  





 This position involves leading the execution of business initiatives through smooth project management, client coordination, and proactive lead generation. You will oversee key commercial opportunities from initial prospecting to final delivery, ensuring each project aligns with the Talent’s annual strategic goals. This includes managing timelines, structuring workflows, following up on action items, and keeping internal teams aligned throughout the project lifecycle. You will also serve as a key link between the Business Director, Talent, and external partners, ensuring clear communication and timely execution at every stage.
 



  





 Success in this role requires excellent time management, flexibility under pressure, and a consistent ability to prioritize competing demands while delivering high\-quality support.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




**Lead Generation and Updates** 



* Identify potential leads using the internal screening process and follow up within 48 hours.
* Proactively track all leads and projects to ensure timely follow\-ups, next steps, and update them on Monday.com.



**Business Development \& Negotiation** 



* Filter, research, and meet with qualified prospects before escalating to the BD.
* Coordinate deal negotiations, review contract terms, and ensure they align with internal standards.
* Promptly respond to external emails including fans, prospects, gifts, PR, and podcast requests.



**Project Management \& Campaign Oversight** 



* Create project scopes, objectives, and KPIs in alignment with each brand deal.
* Develop and track detailed task plans to ensure timely, on\-budget delivery.
* Oversee deliverables, logistics, quality control, and cross\-functional communication.
* Maintain ownership of all project logistics (with assistant support), ensuring execution remains fully aligned with signed contract terms.
* Perform risk management to anticipate and reduce project risks.
* Deliver post\-campaign ROI and performance reports with internal data support.



**Client \& Talent Coordination** 



* Maintain and update the media deck monthly in collaboration with the social/branding team.
* Coordinate talent involvement in campaigns, ensuring on\-time content delivery.
* Organize events, logistics, and ensure smooth communication between BD and internal departments.



**Contract \& Financial Oversight** 



* Review, flag, and help finalize contracts; ensure proper documentation and filing.
* Liaise with Finance for payment follow\-ups and ensure timely invoicing and collections.
* Store all agreements securely in Google Drive and maintain accurate tracking.



**Operational Reporting \& Communication** 



* Maintain up\-to\-date information in Monday.com and CRM.
* Provide timely reports, insights, and summaries to the BD.
* Respond swiftly to urgent WhatsApp or email requests and help the BD stay on track with all priorities.
* Prioritize conflicting needs and manage multiple projects simultaneously with a focus on deadlines and quality.
* Constantly improve workflows and templates for smarter execution.



  





**What You’ll Need** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
* 5–7 years of experience in client management, brand partnerships, business development, or project execution.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage work under pressure independently and with flexibility.
* Excellent time management, prioritization, and multitasking skills.
* High emotional intelligence and openness to constructive feedback.
* Strong writing and speaking skills.
* Resourcefulness and ability to problem\-solve quickly in high\-stakes situations.



  





**Skills Required** 




**Project Management:** 



* Define scopes, KPIs, timelines, and budgets
* Track detailed project plans and daily tasks
* Mitigate risks and ensure timely, high\-quality delivery
* Deliver post\-campaign reports with insights and results



**Communication \& Coordination:** 



* Liaise with prospects, partners, and internal teams
* Ensure seamless coordination between BD, Finance, Creative, and Talent
* Own all project updates and communication channels



**Contracts \& Compliance:** 



* Review and track contracts
* Flag legal or operational concerns
* Ensure proper archiving and contract lifecycle management



**Tools \& Tech:** 



* Proficiency in Google Suite, Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), Monday.com
* CRM/database upkeep
* Familiarity with media deck creation and reporting templates



  





**You’ll Love This Job If You Are:** 



* Strongly organized, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple fast\-moving pieces at once.
* A confident communicator with excellent written and verbal English (Arabic is a plus).
* Naturally proactive, with a high sense of ownership and the ability to work independently.
* Someone who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, client\-facing environment.
* Emotionally mature, discreet with confidential information, and deeply reliable.
* Comfortable working directly with C\-level leaders, clients, and creative teams.
* A forward\-thinking professional who brings ideas, solutions, and accountability.

data.jd_text:
We are looking for a Resident Architect to join our DSA team in Dubai.
 



  





**1\. Role Overview**




  





 To lead the on\-site architectural supervision and consultant services for major construction projects. This includes the administration of post\-contract responsibilities as defined by the appointment, managing and coordinating multidisciplinary site teams where applicable, ensuring alignment with the approved design intent, and monitoring compliance with the project’s contract, codes, and specifications. When appointed in a Design Guardian capacity, the role is limited to safeguarding the design intent through review, coordination, and advisory input only, and does not include construction supervision, inspection, certification, contract administration, or Defects Liability Period services unless expressly agreed and appointed under a separate scope. The role serves as a primary interface between the client, contractors, design teams, and other stakeholders. The exact scope of services may differ on a project\-by\-project basis and will be further defined as part of the project\-specific deliverables..
 



  





**2\.Job Accountabilities Linked To Objectives**




  





 The Resident Architect is responsible for leading the on\-site project team and driving the successful delivery of the project. As the most senior project representative for DSA on site, this role carries the critical responsibility of safeguarding the company’s interests, contractual, legal, and commercial responsibilities throughout the construction phase and ensuring the project aligns with DSA’s standards and obligations.
 



  





 The Resident Architect may be assigned responsibilities across one or multiple projects, as well as strategic or special initiatives aligned with the company's broader objectives. These special assignments may extend beyond project\-specific duties and can include tasks such as conducting quality audits, developing procedures, manuals and supporting internal process improvements \& development.
 



  





 In all cases, the Resident Architect is expected to work closely, not only with their direct team/ the Client but also with their immediate supervisor and line manager to clearly define the scope of responsibilities, deliverables, and resource requirements specific to each assignment. The final scope of duties and level of authority will be established in consultation with and subject to approval by the Site Operations Director, Project Director or relevant senior leadership.
 



  





**A. Design Site Leadership** 




 • Lead the site\-based lead consultancy team (where present) to ensure high standards of quality, compliance, coordination, and delivery across all stakeholders, proactively addressing deficiencies as they arise.
 



 • Oversee and assist with design deliverables, pre\-engineering, shop drawings, RFIs, submittals, inspections, and construction queries to support timely resolution and adherence to project requirements.
 



 • Review and approve works, including but not limited to mock\-ups, sample rooms, materials, and finishes, ensuring alignment with the approved design / designer, specifications, and project requirements.
 



 • Ensure effective design coordination across all disciplines and contribute to the resolution of design and construction\-related conflicts.
 



 • Conduct regular architectural and design\-focused site walks to monitor the implementation of the approved design intent, including look, feel, materiality, and spatial quality.
 



 • Identify, document, and report design, aesthetic, and quality\-related risks or non\-compliances to the LDC / Client through structured observations and reporting.
 



 • Prepare and issue monthly architectural / design guardianship reports summarising site observations, key risks, and matters requiring attention.
 



 • Review and provide comments on material samples, mock\-ups, mood boards, finishes, look \& feel assessments, and sample rooms to support alignment with the approved design intent.
 



 • Provide architectural and interior design clarifications, including aesthetic and design intent matters, where requested by the Client.
 



 • Participate in value engineering and design development discussions, providing input on architectural quality, aesthetic impact, and alignment with the approved design intent.
 



 • Coordinate closely with PMCM, the Contractor, and the wider consultant team during site reviews, technical meetings, and design discussions to maintain alignment between design intent, construction execution, and client expectations.
 



 • Monitor that the executed works reflect the approved design, client expectations, and applicable codes and regulations throughout the construction process.
 



 • Ensure RFIs, approvals, instructions, and IFC changes are managed through the established project communication and authority channels and are properly coordinated across all parties.
 



 • Produce and issue timely internal and external dashboards capturing progress, quality, design alignment, and emerging risks.
 



  





**B. Site Supervision Team Management** 




 • Direct and manage the day\-to\-day performance of DSA's site supervision team (architects, engineers, inspectors, sub\-consultants and the like).
 



 • Ensure all team members are properly briefed on their roles and responsibilities.
 



 • Implement structured delegation and reporting mechanisms.
 



 • Conduct periodic audits, QA/QC / technical reviews, and performance assessments.
 



 • Maintain a collaborative, professional, and high\-performing supervision environment on site.
 



 • Ensure employees / team members conduct are upheld to the highest standards
 



 • Monitor and update in coordination with the Client and Site Operations Director the project, staff deployment, associated schedule and ensure timely delivery of the same at the agreed frequency
 



  





**C. Project \& Contract Administration** 




 • Oversee compliance with the project’s construction contract (FIDIC or equivalent).
 



 • Issue formal communications, manage variations, evaluate contractor claims, and contribute to extension of time assessments.
 



 • Ensure proper documentation, records \& communication protocols are established, used and maintained for all supervision activities.
 



 • Coordinate with the Employer’s Representative and Client\-appointed Consultants.
 



 • Act as Engineer’s Representative / Employer’s Representative if appointed, ensuring responsibilities are discharged in line with the delegated authority.
 



 • Assist in stake holder and lead in team dispute resolution
 



  





**D. Project Coordination \& Stakeholder Interface** 




 • Act as the senior site representative of the lead consultant.
 



 • Establish and manage coordination mechanisms among the consultant team, contractor, suppliers, and client representatives.
 



 • Participate in progress meetings, site coordination meetings, and technical reviews.
 



 • Monitor and steer project progress and associated scheduling and produce relevant reports
 



 • Provide strategic input and advice to the client to ensure project objectives are met.
 



  





**E. Quality \& Compliance Oversight** 




 • Enforce quality control standards and escalate issues that risk the design quality or compliance of the project / deliverables
 



 • Monitor health, safety, and environmental practices on site.
 



 • Participate in final inspections, testing, and commissioning phases.
 



 • Ensure defect lists, non\-conformance reports and site observations are compiled and rectified in line with contract obligations.
 



 • Ensure pre\-engineering deliverables are in line with contract agreement and implement measures to maintain and or rectify resulting shortfalls
 



 • Monitor and advise on change control process
 



  





**F. Leadership \& Mentorship** 




 • Serve as mentor and technical advisor to staff, engineers and sub\-consultants.
 



 • Lead internal training and onboarding of new site staff.
 



 • Foster a knowledge\-sharing culture that emphasizes continuous improvement and professional development to the benefit of the project and company.
 



  





**G. Commercial \& Invoicing Responsibilities** 




 • Coordinate with the head office/accounts team to prepare and validate monthly consultancy service invoices in line with contract terms.
 



 • Review and confirm site\-based and related staff, timesheets for inclusion in monthly billing.
 



 • Collect, verify, and consolidate sub\-consultant timesheets for accuracy, completeness, and scope alignment.
 



 • Track sub\-consultant invoices and ensure timely submission to accounts for processing.
 



 • Maintain a project\-specific log of all invoicing activities, including issue dates, payment terms, and receipt confirmations amongst others.
 



 • Monitor outstanding invoices and follow up with clients and relevant stakeholders to ensure prompt payment.
 



 • Flag and escalate delays in payment or disputed invoices to the Project Director and commercial team.
 



 • Liaise with sub\-consultants regarding their payment status and provide updates on payment cycles and client approvals.
 



 • Ensure compliance with internal financial procedures and contractual invoicing requirements.
 



 • Support monthly project \& financial reporting with updates on invoice status, forecasted income, and payment risks.
 



 • Assist in reconciling client payment records with internal accounts to resolve discrepancies, if any.
 



 • Track any approved variations or scope changes and coordinate with the commercial team to ensure these are invoiced accordingly.
 



  





**3\. Qualification / Experience / Requirements**




  





 • Qualified Architect (BArch / MArch) with minimum 15 years’ experience; at least 10 years on\-site in the Middle East.
 



 • Proven experience as a Resident Architect on large\-scale or complex projects.
 



 • Strong working knowledge of FIDIC contract administration and construction management practices.
 



 • Experience managing multidisciplinary supervision teams in fast\-track environments.
 



 • Familiar with UAE/ Regional Authority codes, regulations, and approval procedures.
 



 • PMP, MCIOB, or similar certifications are advantageous.
 



 • Strong documentation, reporting, technical and problem\-solving capabilities.
 



  





 Interested candidates can share their resume directly on recruit.dxb@dsa\-arch.com mentioning "Resident Architect" as a subject.

**Job Description**
 Join our dynamic corporate team and become part of Aman Group. With offices strategically located around the world (Zug, London, Dubai, Singapore, Bangkok, Miami and New York), our corporate colleagues are at the forefront of driving innovation and excellence for our ultra\-luxury brand.
   

  

**Role**
 We are seeking a passionate Senior Accountant to join our team in Dubai. You will support project finance activities, manage budgets and forecasts, ensure accurate financial reporting, and maintain compliance with controls and regulations—playing a key role in driving financial efficiency and project success.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage project budgets, ensuring alignment with project plans and contract terms.
* Track and report on project expenditures; identify deviations from the budget.
* Prepare financial forecasts and perform variance analysis comparing budgeted costs to actual costs.
* Analyze financial data to provide insights and recommendations for cost control and optimization.
* Translate project contracts into detailed financial plans; track project performance against these plans.
* Update and maintain project schedules to reflect accurate financial status.
* Monitor project cash flows and manage capital calls as needed.
* Ensure timely payments to contractors and vendors, tracking payment schedules and amounts.
* Review and monitor changes in project agreements; update financial records accordingly.
* Ensure compliance with contract terms related to financial management.
* Prepare regular financial reports for project director and stakeholders; highlight key financial metrics.
* Ensure adherence to internal controls, accounting policies, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain accurate and organized financial documentation for audit purposes.
* Collaborate with project director to provide financial insights and support decision\-making.


**Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA, ACCA, or similar certification is required
* Arabic speaking is essential
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience in project development accounting or a similar role
* Strong understanding of project financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management
* Proficiency in accounting software and financial management systems
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities
* Effective communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams


**Benefits**
 At Aman Group, we believe our colleagues are at the core of our success. We offer competitive benefits, including exciting global career opportunities within a rapidly expanding company. We prioritize and support your professional journey, ensuring you feel valued, included, and at home.

ChillBase studio is an independent and innovative player in the gaming industry. We’re fueled by our passion for crafting outstanding products.
 



  





 We’re creating
 **OneState** 
 , a mobile life simulator built in Unity. Our art team is facing ambitious challenges as we develop the project with a realistic approach and high standards for visual quality and technical solutions. We use modern technologies and tools, continuously refining our pipelines and aiming for the highest level of quality and immersion.
 



  





 If you are seeking to be a part of an engaged team, work on captivating projects with minimal bureaucracy, and receive regular, constructive feedback, then you’ll find your place with us.
 



  





**Expectations** 




  





**What we want to see** 



* Experience as an Art Director or Head of Art on game projects
* Strong expertise in mobile AAA realism
* Deep understanding of mobile platform limitations and how to work within them
* Experience building art systems, standards, and processes
* Experience collaborating with producers and directors as partners
* Strong skills in presenting and defending creative decisions
* Cross platform experience with mobile, PC, or console projects is a strong plus
* Strategic mindset
* High level of ownership and responsibility
* Strong communication skills
* Focus on results and business value
* Willingness to work in a partnership model rather than manual micromanagement



  





**What you will be doing** 



* Shaping and evolving the project’s art strategy together with the CCO
* Building an autonomous art structure including roles, ownership, standards, and processes
* Ensuring AAA level quality and visual consistency across the product
* Making key visual decisions and defending them at the producer and director level
* Developing head level roles and growing strong leaders within the art team
* Managing the balance between quality, timelines, cost, and value
* Growing the art direction as a driver of product and IP growth



  





**Benefits** 




  





**Growth and development** 




 Our project is actively growing, as well as the team that creates it. We invest in the growth of each specialist and regularly review salaries based on performance. Moreover, we have a promotion system that allows specialists to showcase their talents in more responsible positions.
 



  





**Comfortable conditions** 




 You can choose various work types: hybrid or office. Also we have flexible hours with the option of taking days off.
 



  





**Care for employees** 




 We offer sick days without salary loss, assistance in difficult life situations, no bureaucratic nightmares and processes for the sake of processes.

 If you’re ready to join the team at our hub in Dubai, we will help you make it happen.
 



  





**Employment** 




 We offer an employment system, including official labor relations in Dubai, as well as any other options that suit you.
 



  





**We carefully review every application and will definitely reach out if your profile matches the role’s requirements. If you do not receive a response within 14 calendar days, it means we are not moving forward with your application at this stage. We’d be happy to reconnect in the future — please keep an eye on our openings.**

data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.

* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.

* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style

* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio

* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.

* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management

* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.

 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future.
