Embodying this spirit of the University, G
data.jd_text:
Georgetown University in Qatar (GU\-Q) is dedicated to fulfilling Georgetown University's mission of promoting intellectual, ethical and spiritual understanding through serious and sustained discourse among people of different faiths, cultures, and beliefs. Embodying this spirit of the University, Georgetown's Qatar campus undertakes education, research, and service in order to advance knowledge and provide students and the community with a holistic educational experience that produces global citizens committed to the service of humankind. We demonstrate the values of Georgetown University; seek to build upon the world\-class reputation of the Edmund A. Walsh School of Foreign Service; and work with our partner, Qatar Foundation, in its endeavors to achieve the Qatar National Vision 2030\.
   

  

**Requirements**
 The Writing Center Manager,
 **located in Doha, Qatar** 
 , leads the strategic and day\-to\-day operations of the Writing Center, advancing Writing Across the Curriculum (WAC) initiatives and promoting excellence in academic writing across disciplines. The role combines teaching, faculty development, research, and program innovation, while supervising professional staff and peer tutors. Working closely with the Director for Student Academic Success, the role contributes to institutional teaching and learning priorities.
   

  

**This position is full\-time, for a one\-year term, with the possibility of renewal. The position is eligible for sponsorship and benefits, including medical insurance, housing allowance, home leave travel, and dependent education support. As it is based in Doha, Qatar and offers no relocation assistance, GU\-Q invites only locally based candidates who already hold a valid Qatar residence permit to apply.**
**Key Accountabilities**
* Coordinate the operations and activities of a dynamic writing center. Provide expert tutoring for students' needs in academic writing across the disciplines.
* Lead Writing Across the Curriculum (WAC) initiatives, collaborating with faculty across disciplines and in key first year courses, to strengthen the development of student writing.
* Design and implement innovative programs that promote reading, critical thinking, and information literacy across the curriculum.
* Contribute to the Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SOTL) through research, assessment and publication of writing center practices and outcomes.
* Teach, subject to curricular need, first\-year writing courses, summer writing workshops, and other special writing programs/courses (cross\-registration, ABP program, etc.).


**Key Activities**
* Provide expert tutoring for the various academic needs of GU\-Q students.
* Meet with faculty to discuss the needs of students in academic writing across the disciplines.
* Partner with faculty to design discipline\-specific writing assignments and integrate writing\-to\-learn pedagogies into their courses.
* Facilitate faculty development workshops on writing pedagogy, assignment design, and responding to student writing.
* Identify and disseminate resources for academic writing and academic achievement.
* Develop and lead innovative programs that integrate reading, writing, and critical thinking skills, including digital literacy initiatives.
* Conduct research and assessment on writing center effectiveness and student learning outcomes. Share findings through presentations and publications.
* Assist the Director for Student Academic Success in the delivery of teaching, learning and assessment initiatives, based on current trends in writing center scholarship and evidence\-based literacy practices.
* Manage project development.
* Lead writing workshops and other writing\-related seminars and labs.
* Teach at least one first year writing course per semester.
* Administer and assist with the English writing assessment at New Student Orientation/Hoya Welcome Week.
* Manage and oversee the work of direct reports, including scheduling, setting and reviewing performance objectives, and identifying and scheduling training and development needs.
* Liaise with Human Resources to manage recruitment, hiring, onboarding and offboarding of direct reports, as required.
* Recruit, hire, train, supervise and mentor student peer tutors and fellows in supporting critical reading and multimodal composition.


**Knowledge And Skills**
* Knowledge of writing center dynamics and current best practices in writing center administration.
* Knowledge of Writing Across the Curriculum/Writing in the Disciplines theories and pedagogies.
* Understanding evidence\-based approaches to teaching reading comprehension and critical thinking.
* Familiarity with SOTL methodologies, including assessment design and educational research.
* Ability to work well with various forms of technology to support program operations and writing development including AI tools, Google Suite, Microsoft Office Suite, online data management software, social media tools, collaborative writing spaces, etc.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work well in a collaborative, learning\-focused, team environment.
* Strong facilitation and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated commitment to assessment and evidence\-based practice preferred.


**Qualifications**
* Master degree in Rhetoric and Composition, Applied Linguistics, TESOL, Education or a related writing\-intensive field. Doctoral degree preferred.


**Experience**
* 5\+ years of relevant work experience in higher education in the MENA/SWANA region.
* 5\+ years of experience teaching or tutoring academic writing at the college level.
* Experience working with diverse learners.
* 2\+ years' experience with supervising/coordinating/managing staff and project development.
* Previous administrative experience.
* Experience with Writing Across the Curriculum programs or faculty development preferred.


**Current Georgetown Employees**
 If you currently work at Georgetown University, please exit this website and login to GMS (gms.georgetown.edu) using your Net ID and password. Then select the Career worklet on your GMS Home dashboard to view Jobs at Georgetown.
   

  

**Submission Guidelines**
 Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at Georgetown University in Qatar, you must submit a resume/CV for each position of interest. Documents are not kept on file for future positions.
   

  

**Need Assistance**
 Need some assistance with the application process? Contact us at guqhr@georgetown.edu.
   

  

**EEO Statement**
 GU is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, citizenship, color, disability, family responsibilities, gender identity and expression, genetic information, marital status, matriculation, national origin, race, religion, personal appearance, political affiliation, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Georgetown University offers a wide variety of comprehensive and competitive benefits. Benefits packages include comprehensive health, dental and vision plans, disability and life insurance coverage, retirement savings programs, tuition assistance, voluntary insurance options (including group legal, accident, and critical illness), and much more. Whatever your need, the Office of Faculty and Staff Benefits will be standing by to support you. You can learn more about the benefits offered to eligible faculty and staff at https://benefits.georgetown.edu or view the online interactive benefits guide for more information.
   

  

 Georgetown University in Qatar (GU\-Q) is located on the Education City campus in Doha, Qatar and offers a variety of lifelong learning opportunities for the community. The four\-year Bachelor of Science in Foreign Service (BSFS) degree program is delivered by the world renowned Edmund A. Walsh School of Foreign Service with a curriculum that is identical to that offered to students in Washington, D. C. Each year, GU\-Q admits a class of approximately 100 students, primarily from the Middle East, South Asia and Southeast Asia. GU\-Q is sponsored by Qatar Foundation and is one of six American universities located within Education City. All students have access to a superb range of recreational and housing facilities offered by Qatar Foundation and they take classes in classrooms equipped with state of the art technology. The campus currently boasts the presence of one of the largest public access libraries in Qatar. The compensation, benefits, terms of employment and professional development opportunities for GU\-Q faculty and staff are highly competitive.

data.jd_text:
The job holder will be responsible for participating and leading all retail project / site development phases from schematic design through construction, including conceptual and detailed planning, designing, material specification, contractor evaluation and finalization, site supervision and control. The job holder will also be responsible for renovation and maintenance of existing stores with regards to any civil, electrical, mechanical, plumbing and carpentry works.
 



  





**Qualifications**




  




* Graduate Degree in Architecture/ Planning \& Design/ Applied Science / Civil Engineering
* Knowledge of spaces, spatial layouts, relations, conceptual sketching, 3D modelling
* Knowledge of Architectural detailing, Construction Methodology and Civil work estimation
* Knowledge in AutoCAD, 3D Max, Photoshop usage
* Exposure to the latest building materials, building systems and interior trends through formal or informal training (on\-the\-job experience)
* 7\-8 years of Interior / Retail Store / Building designing and Project Management experience



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





**Retail Format Design / Re\-design** 



* Conceptualize / Redesign retail formats for the Concept in line with the customer, mall requirements and latest market trends
* Develop complete design for the showroom that will include a comprehensive floor plan, exterior elevations, interior elevations, A/c diffuse allocation, lightning, graphic imaging (3D Presentation) and all material selections and finishes
* Develop designs for all other features / utilities of the Mall or store such as building placement / orientation, parking lot layout / flow, service vehicle access
* Deliver detailed specifications and clear, concise, comprehensive, and complete engineering / interior drawings as required
* Ensure that all the designs and drawings are as per the company standards
* Develop the zoning in the store as per the categories of products to be displayed by bearing in mind the principles of space management and profiles of the target consumers
* Review and process all shop drawing/sample submissions and consult within the Projects Team and External Consultants, as appropriate, to ensure the design intent is being maintained
* Conduct existing conditions surveys and prepare architectural base plans, sections, elevations and details as appropriate to document relevant conditions
* Coordinate with the Retail Operations and VM team to get their inputs on the design, which includes the floor plan, elevations etc.
* Provide expertise in detail development and assisting in researching products and systems that accomplish the design intent
* Review and recommend to the retail team any changes that may be required to renovate the existing stores



  





**Site Project Management** 



* Assist in site selection and prepare the detailed survey report by performing on\-site design services, interpreting drawings, specs, codes, standards, regulatory requirements, and carrying out field engineering work
* Prepare detailed project plans for site development including project costing, timelines and development schedules and coordinate for approvals
* Nominate, evaluate and appoint consultants and contractors / suppliers / vendors including negotiation of rates and contractual terms and obligations
* Manage vendor relationships including conducting planning session with vendors and service providers and define project and performance expectations
* Identify and evaluate new products / solutions including material to be used bearing in mind quality and cost effectiveness
* Provide material specifications and oversee procurement of the material from suppliers
* Coordinate with external agencies like Architectural Consultants, Material suppliers, Construction agencies etc so as to ensure that the project is completed with in the scheduled time period in a efficient and effective way
* Supervise all the activities on\-site and coordinate with Concept to regularly provide feedback on the progress of work/project
* Guide and manage the manpower deployed onsite including Supervisors and contractor labour



  





**Technical Supervision**

* Any electricity related work in the existing stores and new stores
* Any carpentry related work in the existing stores and new stores
* Any plumbing related work in the existing stores and new stores

* Coordinate with MEP, municipal authorities and PRO for approvals of Civil signage’s and municipality permissions



  





**People Management** 



* Manage the performance of the team – set annual performance goals, monitor performance and provide constructive feedback to improve performance.
* Identify their training and development needs and ensure their fulfilment
* Develop and mentor subordinates to move to the next higher level of job through career planning

**What You Will Do**
 The Project Engineer plays a pivotal role in delivering Building Management Systems (BMS) and Extra\-Low Voltage (ELV) Systems projects, including
 **CCTV, Access Control, Active and Passive Structured Cabling, and related security/communication systems** 
 . Based in Kuwait, you will be part of a dynamic and expanding team responsible for
 **end‑to‑end project execution** 
 , from design review to installation, testing, commissioning, and handover.
   

  

 You will also support
 **pre‑sales, estimation, and technical solutioning** 
 , contributing to the overall growth and success of the business.
   

  

**How You Will Do It**
 As a Project Engineer, you will oversee all technical and execution aspects of BMS \& ELV projects, including:
   

  

* Leading design review, installation supervision, and quality assurance for ELV systems such as CCTV, Access Control, Structured Cabling (Active \& Passive), Intercom, and related subsystems.

* Configuring OT/IT networks relevant to ELV systems and developing BMS graphics and server configurations.

 You will apply strong problem‑solving skills to maintain a proactive approach, ensuring profitable project delivery and building long‑term customer trust.

* Proven experience delivering BMS \& ELV installation projects in the GCC (Kuwait preferred).
* Strong understanding of ELV installation standards, cable routing, termination, and system integration.
* Experience with BMS programming and integration using Modbus, BACnet, LonWorks, MSTP, IP, KNX, OPC.

* Excellent communication skills, proactive mindset, and ability to work independently.

Job Purpose:
 



 To lead and direct Asyad Logistics’ Freight Forwarding business in Oman, ensuring profitable growth, commercial expansion, operational excellence, and strong financial control across Air, Sea, Road Freight, and Customs Clearance activities. The role carries full P\&L accountability for the Freight Forwarding business, with responsibility for driving revenue growth, margin improvement, service quality, business transformation, and disciplined working capital management including timely billing, collections, and cash flow performance. The role supports Oman’s positioning as a regional logistics hub while ensuring compliance with ASYAD Group standards, OIA governance, Oman Labour Law, customs regulations, and international trade requirements.
 



  





 Main Accountabilities and Responsibilities:
 


* Develop and execute the Freight Forwarding strategy, annual business plan, and budget in alignment with Asyad Logistics’ growth ambitions and national logistics objectives.
* Drive commercial expansion by winning new business, penetrating target sectors, strengthening customer relationships, and building a healthy pipeline across Air, Sea, Road Freight, and Customs Clearance services.
* Identify and develop new products, trade lanes, customer segments, and value\-added forwarding solutions that enhance revenue, competitiveness, and market share.
* Build and strengthen strategic relationships with airlines, shipping lines, overseas agents, transport partners, customs stakeholders, and key government entities to improve capability, reach, and commercial positioning.
* Lead the Freight Forwarding business to support Oman’s role as a competitive regional gateway and logistics hub.
* Ensure all strategic initiatives and business activities are aligned with ASYAD Group standards, OIA governance requirements, and relevant regulatory frameworks.
* Hold full P\&L accountability for the Freight Forwarding business, ensuring sustainable revenue growth, margin improvement, cost discipline, and delivery of agreed financial targets.
* Lead end\-to\-end Freight Forwarding operations across Air, Sea, Road Freight, and Customs Clearance to ensure service reliability, operational excellence, compliance, and customer satisfaction.
* Drive pricing discipline, job profitability, vendor cost control, and operational efficiency to improve gross margin and EBIT performance.
* Ensure strong financial leadership across the business through timely and accurate billing, reduction of revenue leakage, disciplined credit control, proactive collections follow\-up, and close monitoring of overdue receivables and cash conversion.
* Oversee operational and commercial controls to ensure timely job closure, complete cost capture, accurate invoicing, and proper handover to finance.
* Manage key cost drivers including transport procurement, vendor agreements, subcontracted services, manpower, claims exposure, and service failures.
* Ensure full compliance with customs rules, international trade regulations, internal governance requirements, and health, safety, security, and quality standards.
* Maintain service excellence and resilience across the forwarding network while ensuring competitiveness in rates, transit times, and customer responsiveness.
* Lead business improvement initiatives to simplify processes, strengthen controls, improve visibility, and raise productivity across commercial and operational functions.
* Drive transformation in areas such as digital forwarding, performance dashboards, shipment visibility, pricing governance, job costing discipline, and exception management.
* Implement performance measurement frameworks that track revenue growth, gross profit, yield, billing timeliness, collections, DSO, productivity, service quality, and customer retention.

* Develop organizational capability through coaching, succession planning, performance management, and Omanization initiatives.
* Set clear performance expectations for revenue generation, profitability, billing discipline, collections support, operational delivery, and customer satisfaction.
* Promote cross\-functional collaboration with finance, procurement, HR, IT, QHSE, and other business units to ensure strong business execution.

**Role Overview:** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced
 **Project Manager – Marine** 
 to lead and deliver marine construction projects in the UAE. The ideal candidate will be responsible for end\-to\-end project execution, including planning, budgeting, scheduling, and on\-site supervision, while ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, safety standards, and local regulations. * Manage marine construction projects from initiation through completion

**Procurement \& Subcontractor Management** 



* Coordinate procurement of materials, equipment, and marine resources
* Manage subcontractors and suppliers to ensure performance, quality, and schedule adherence
* Review subcontractor progress, payments, and deliverables



**Reporting \& Risk Management** 



* Prepare progress reports, cost reports, and forecasts for senior management

 **0 years of experience**

**Technical Knowledge:** 




 Strong understanding of marine construction methodologies, including dredging, piling, quay walls, breakwaters, and coastal structures.

**JOB SCOPE** 




 The Director of Business Development is responsible for leading the growth and expansion of Oman Airports’ airport consultancy, PPP, concession, and O\&M business portfolio by identifying and securing strategic business opportunities across regional and international markets. The role oversees business development strategy, client engagement, bid leadership, commercial negotiations, and partnership development while driving market positioning, revenue growth, and competitive advantage. The position also leads cross\-functional teams in structuring complex aviation and infrastructure deals, managing stakeholder relationships, supporting investment evaluations, and ensuring alignment with corporate governance, strategic objectives, and long\-term business growth initiatives.
 



  





**Key ACCOUNTABILITIES** 




**1\. Strategic Business Development \& Growth** 



* Lead the identification, prioritization, and pursuit of new business opportunities across airport consultancy, PPP concessions, and O\&M contracts
* Define and execute the business development strategy aligned with the growth ambitions of Oman Airports
* Build and manage a robust pipeline of opportunities across target regions, with a focus on emerging and high\-growth aviation markets
* Drive market entry strategies, including partnerships, joint ventures, and consortium formations



**2\. Opportunity Origination \& Client Engagement** 



* Establish and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders including governments, airport authorities, investors, and industry partners
* Proactively originate opportunities through market intelligence, networking, and strategic positioning
* Represent the organization in high\-level engagements, industry forums, and client meetings
* Position the company as a trusted advisor in airport development, operations, and optimization



**3\. Leadership of Bids, Proposals \& Commercial Strategy** 



* Oversee the end\-to\-end bid and proposal process for consultancy, PPP, and O\&M opportunities
* Provide strategic direction to the Proposal \& Bid Management team to ensure compelling, compliant, and competitive submissions
* Define win strategies, value propositions, and competitive positioning for each opportunity
* Ensure alignment between technical solutions, financial models, and commercial frameworks



**4\. PPP, O\&M \& Consultancy Deal Structuring** 



* Lead the structuring of complex PPP and concession opportunities, including commercial frameworks and risk allocation
* Guide the development of financial and commercial models in collaboration with finance teams
* Negotiate key commercial terms with clients, partners, and stakeholders
* Oversee the evaluation of investment opportunities, including strategic fit, risk profile, and expected returns



**5\. Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Team Management** 



* Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams across business development, proposals, finance, legal, and technical functions
* Foster collaboration and alignment across internal departments to deliver integrated solutions
* Set performance targets, monitor outcomes, and drive accountability across the business development function
* Build internal capabilities in airport advisory, PPP structuring, and bid management



**6\. Market Intelligence \& Competitive Positioning** 



* Monitor global aviation trends, airport privatization programs, and competitor activities
* Provide strategic insights to senior leadership on market dynamics, risks, and opportunities
* Identify differentiators and continuously refine the company’s value proposition in consultancy and airport management
* Drive thought leadership initiatives to enhance brand positioning



**7\. Governance, Risk \& Performance Management** 



* Ensure all business development activities align with corporate governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks
* Oversee bid/no\-bid decisions based on strategic, financial, and operational considerations
* Track and report on pipeline performance, win rates, and revenue generation
* Ensure disciplined handover of won projects to operations and finance teams



**8\. Partnerships \& Ecosystem Development** 



* Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic partners, advisors, and consortium members for major bids
* Lead relationship management with key partners across PPP and consultancy engagements
* Strengthen the organization’s ecosystem to enhance competitiveness in large\-scale international tenders



  





**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Aviation, Engineering, Business, or Economics; an MBA or equivalent advanced degree is strongly preferred.
* 10\+ years of leadership experience in airport operations, infrastructure, aviation strategy, with at least 5 years in leadership position or international role.
* Experience leading global airport concession bids, acquisitions, or major aviation infrastructure programs.
* Experience with emerging market operations, public\-private partnerships, and stakeholder engagement with governments or multilateral institutions.
* Understanding of commercial aviation services and airport ecosystems (ground services, retail, cargo, digital).

data.jd_text:
**Director of Project Management** 




  





 Majid Al Futtaim is seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Project Management to lead the delivery of large\-scale residential, non\-residential, infrastructure, and landscape development projects.
 



 This leadership role will oversee the full project lifecycle — from planning and procurement through execution, handover, and post\-delivery customer experience. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality, safety, and sustainability.
 



  





**PURPOSE OF THE JOB** 




  





 • The Director of Project Management reports to the Chief Development Officer and works in close partnership with the Director of Development. The Director of Project Management is responsible for the delivery of all residential, non\-residential buildings and infrastructure (civil and landscape) works for the development.
 



 • The role requires development of short and long term planning for delivery of the project business plan. Monthly forecasting and monitoring of progress of works (cost time and quality) to handover is required to ensure cash and revenue projections are achieved.
 



 • Bring together, direct and manage all PM staff, contractors and consultants with clear briefing and management for all works, demonstrating a strong presence on site as a “hands on” leader.
 



 • Control time, cost, quality and health and safety via clear direction and management tools (dashboards, programs, budgets, meetings) to ensure design intent is delivered, resulting in a positive customer experience combined with efficiency of operations.
 



 • Prioritise response to any direct requests or instructions given by Senior Shareholder representatives and ensure full resolution agreed with the Shareholder expeditiously, at all times in liaison with and sign off by the DM team of such process.
 



 • Develop Best Practice methodology in benchmarking and value engineering to ensure cost efficiency without jeopardizing initial development concepts/customer expectations at time of pre\-sales.
 



 • Review existing operations \& administrative systems \& streamline as required to optimize resource efficiency.
 



 • Prepare clear \& concise RFP’s consistent with budgets for consultant \& contractor selection process as necessary \& in liaison with DM team.
 



 • Lead \& report on WOW initiatives as relate to PM operations and Capex across development projects.
 



 • Working closely with the customer experience/FM teams and managing the aftercare team is essential to ensure a positive customer experience continues post\-handover.
 



 • Develop safety, sustainability \& innovation strategies and targets for each business plan year.
 



 • Report regularly, and with clarity and transparently at all times.
 



 • Manage internal audits to ensure that company procedures and policies are being followed and adhered to.
 



  





**PRIMARY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Key Tasks** 




 • Manage delivery of all residential, non\-residential built form and infrastructure works.
 



 • Use, and develop where necessary, key processes and procedures to ensure monitoring and management of time, cost and quality for all projects.
 



 • Work in close cooperation with the Director of Development on design of all works and ensure the delivery of design intent is achieved.
 



 • Develop and manage budget for all costs to ensure KPI’s are achieved.
 



 • Work with CDO, development and finance teams to develop business plan strategy.
 



 • Forecast and manage handover of all works to ensure Business Plan cash flow and revenue projections are achieved on, or ahead of target.
 



 • Procure all services with clear and concise briefing, pre\-qualification, negotiation and appointment in line with company policies and procedures.
 



 • Focus on cash management of works to ensure the most efficient use of company\-wide CAPEX.
 



 • Ensure strategy of handover of works to FM is comprehensive and well planned starting at the concept design stage, to ensure seamless handover resulting in a positive customer experience.
 



 • Ensure supportive relationship with Customer Experience Team to enhance the customer experience at all touch points relative to the PM function.
 



 • HSE compliance to be in line with best practice to maintain/improve track record.
 



 • Risk management framework regularly updated and managed to avoid negative impacts and ensure efficient, financially and corporate compliance via transparent, sustainable and safe operations at all time.
 



 • Ensure approvals/licenses and other obligations are procured and adhered to for all works.
 



 • Develop a meeting framework to ensure clear briefing, direction and follow up of the PM team, contractors, consultants and liaison with other in house staff to meet agreed KPIs.
 



 • Provide clear, concise and transparent reporting and communication to senior management on a monthly basis, including weekly meeting and updates to CDO.
 



 • Ensure sustainability initiatives are developed and targets adhered to for the project.
 



 • Foster innovation within the team to achieve companywide innovation targets.
 



 • Develop and foster strong relationships with key government authorities, contractors and consultants to ensure smooth management and delivery of projects.
 



 • Foster motivation and develop a collaborative team environment where the Development Management \& Project Management teams work seamlessly.
 



  





**PERSON SPECIFICATION** 




**Education \& Experience** 




 • BSc in Project Management, Engineering, or related discipline.
 



 • 15\+ years of Middle East work experience in the development field, with the majority of experience being client\-side.
 



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




  





**Functional Knowledge** 




 • Deep knowledge of built form and infrastructure within large scale/multiple project environments.
 



 • Strong understanding of development processes and procedures.
 



 • Strong understanding of customer needs and business value drivers.
 



 • Proficient in software applications such as AutoCAD, MS Project, MS Office, BIM, and related systems.
 



  





**Technical Competencies** 




 • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
 



 • Strong planning, organizational, and project management skills.
 



 • Strong analytical skills.
 



 • Strong budgeting and future planning skills.
 



  





**Management Competencies** 




 • Leads by example.
 



 • Team player.
 



 • Strong interpersonal relationship skills.
 



 • Initiative and proactive mindset.
 



 • Diplomacy and stakeholder management.
 



  





**Communication** 




 • Effective writing and reporting skills.
 



 • Ability to deliver presentations across a variety of situations and topics.
 



 • Strong relationship development and maintenance skills.
 



 • Strong internal communication capabilities.
 



 • Fluency in English, both verbal and written, is preferred. Fluency in Arabic would be advantageous but not essential.
 



  





**Core Values** 




 • Bold
 



 • Passionate
 



 • Togetherness

data.jd_text:
CNS is a technology company that powers the future by providing digital solutions essential to support all enterprise and human development. While growing and managing a robust pool of supplier\-partners for the benefit of our clients has always been a priority, we are constantly re\-inventing ourselves.
   

  

 Founded in 1987 with more than 30 years of experience, CNS employs over 320 employees including more than 250 certified engineers. We offer in\-depth expertise and a range of best\-in\-class products that support the digital transformation of all major industries. With offices in three countries, we have an extensive reach into, and regional knowledge of the Middle East markets.
   

  

 A shift into levering our many years of experience to develop pioneering software in\-house will add yet another dimension to our highly innovative solutions\-portfolio.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Project Coordinator will support Project Managers in planning, executing, and closing projects across CNS Oman by managing schedules, documentation, reporting, and stakeholder coordination. The role involves working closely with internal teams, customers, vendors, and subcontractors to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and in line with CNS standards.
   

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Support project managers in preparing and maintaining project plans, schedules, trackers, and status reports for CNS projects in Oman.
* Coordinate project meetings, prepare agendas and minutes, record decisions and action items, and follow up to ensure timely closure.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and issues, and escalate any deviations from plan to the project manager.
* Maintain up\-to\-date project documentation including scope documents, approvals, change requests, meeting notes, and progress updates in the designated repositories.
* Coordinate with internal teams (technical, service delivery, sales, procurement, finance, logistics) to support timely execution of project activities.
* Liaise with customers, vendors, and subcontractors on routine coordination matters, scheduling, document submissions, and implementation updates.
* Support procurement and logistics follow\-up for project materials, licenses, hardware, software, and third\-party services, ensuring alignment with project timelines.
* Assist with project financial administration, including monitoring purchase requests, invoices, cost records, and ensuring supporting documents are complete for billing.
* Prepare regular project dashboards and summary reports for management and stakeholders, highlighting progress, issues, and upcoming milestones.
* Support testing, handover, customer acceptance, and project closure activities, including collection of sign\-offs and preparation of lessons learned.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Professional certification such as PMP, CAPM, or PRINCE2 Foundation (or equivalent) is preferred .


**Experience**
* 3–5 years of experience in project coordination, project administration, or PMO support, preferably in IT, systems integration, or technology services.
* Experience supporting infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, software, or managed services projects in the GCC / Oman.


**Skills \& Abilities**
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills; excellent written and verbal communication; proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); ability to maintain trackers and reports; attention to detail; ability to manage multiple priorities; stakeholder coordination; documentation control; basic commercial awareness.
* Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, Asana); understanding of project governance and change control; exposure to IT service delivery environments; basic understanding of contracts and SLAs.


**Additional Information**
*Compliance with policies and procedures based on the ISO standards adopted by CNS.*

data.jd_text:
We are a leading international law and professional services firm providing legal, corporate and fiduciary services to global corporations, financial institutions, capital market participants and investment fund managers. With a global presence spanning the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we advise on the laws of Bermuda, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Guernsey, Ireland and Jersey.
 



  





 We treat everyone as the intelligent professional they are. Our approach is to trust and empower our people to deliver consistently, and enable them to succeed. Diversity is our secret weapon – it’s the sheer breadth of Walkers people that makes us who we are – gathered from across the globe and fluent in languages, jurisdictions and cultures that help us to mirror our clients and keep our own thinking in tune with the world in which we operate.
 



  





**Overview Of Role** 




  





 This role will ideally be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office.
 



 We are keen to hear from qualified candidates in London who are open to relocating to Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore.
 



  





 This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced compliance professional with a background in the legal or professional services sector to join a team dealing with conflicts of interest and client confidentiality matters.
 



  





 Reporting to our Director of Conflicts and joining the OGC team, the successful candidate will assist with the development of a specialised team of conflicts professionals responsible for analysing, advising on and resolving legal and commercial conflicts of interest, information barriers and share dealing requests. This is to ensure we comply with all applicable regulations, professional rules of conduct, contractual terms related to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and protect client relationships and our reputation.
 



  





 Our conflicts analysts assist with the resolution of complex conflicts issues, deal with sensitive confidential matters, and carry out conflict checks associated with share dealing requests and lateral hires into the business.
 



  





 The Senior Conflicts Manager will work closely with the Director of Conflicts on the ongoing development of our policies, controls and processes as they relate to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, information barriers, share dealing and Market Abuse Regulations. This will include optimising our use of tech/automation (including
 *Intapp* 
 ), standardising and simplifying our policies and processes across the Walkers group, and building an optimal team shape that provides agility, efficiency, consistency and excellent service to the business and our clients.
 



  





**Duties, Responsibilities \& Person Specification** 




  




* Day\-to\-day management of conflicts advisors within the relevant time zone (including leading the recruitment of additional conflicts advisors).
* Act as a point of escalation for the team and the business on all legal and commercial conflicts issues, analysing and resolving issues in accordance with applicable regulations, professional rules and Walkers' own policy and procedures.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across Walkers globally, acting as a point of contact in relation to all conflicts and client confidentiality queries and leading communications across the business in this area.
* Together with other senior team members, lead on internal training as it relates to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, share dealing and insider lists.
* Identify any weaknesses or areas for potential improvement in our existing client onboarding system (Intapp Intake) and, working with the Director of Conflicts and the Compliance Business Systems team, recommend enhancements that streamline/simplify processes for team and the business, and/or strengthen our controls.
* Working with the Director of Conflicts and key stakeholders from across the business, develop and deliver a phased programme of work that: (i) rapidly enhances our conflicts offering/service delivery to the business (including through improved time zone coverage/capacity, responsiveness, efficiency and expertise); (ii) enables us to provide a fully centralised conflict checking/analysis function within the next two years.
* Support the Director of Conflicts in driving quality, consistency, service excellence, efficiency, proactivity and adaptability across the Conflicts team.
* Assist the Director of Conflicts in developing and leading people initiatives within the Conflicts team to drive development of expertise and skills, attraction and retention, and fostering a high\-performing, collaborative and open team culture.
* Input into regular reporting to senior management and/or other stakeholders as required.
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives which impact or relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality.
* Keep abreast with developments in regulation, technology and the market which are relevant to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, market abuse/insider trading, and information barriers.



  





**Education, Skills \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in law, business, finance or another relevant field.
* Experience in a compliance or in\-house legal role in an international law firm or professional services environment.
* Compliance expert with deep technical and practical knowledge of legal conflicts of interest, commercial conflicts and client confidentiality, with some knowledge of Market Abuse Regs.
* Familiarity with Intapp Intake.
* Experience of policy work.
* Experience of people management, including supervision/management of large teams and experience devising and driving people initiatives (including around recruitment and development).
* Proven track record of delivering change and process improvements.
* Experience working in an offshore environment or with offshore structures would be helpful but not required
* Strategic: ability to work in pursuit of a clear strategic direction, align the team's priorities with those of the wider OGC team and the firm, and proactively identify improvements.
* Leadership: ability to lead and inspire the team, drive collaboration and foster a high\-performing team culture.
* Technical: deep knowledge of relevant regulations and professional rules as they relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and an ability to apply these in practice.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills: solutions\-orientated with the ability to interpret complex fact patterns to reach decisions or develop clear recommendations.
* Quality: strong attention to detail and produces high quality work product.
* Judgement: confident taking decisions, with sound judgement of when to escalate issues or seek further opinions.
* Adaptable: willingness to embrace change and uncertainty and manage competing demands in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment; willing to constructively challenge the status quo.
* Communication: strong verbal and written communication skills, ensuring communications are properly targeted, persuasive, accurate and accessible.
* Emotional intelligence: ability to empathise, understand, and manage emotions effectively, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment.
* Collaborative: builds strong and effective relationships with stakeholders and peers; works collaboratively with colleagues across the business. A "one\-team" ethos.
* Commercial: sound, commercially driven decision\-making. A relentless focus on service excellence.
* Familiarity with Intapp.



  





**Other** 




  




* Walkers is a global business and this role may therefore require audio or video conferencing outside of normal business hours.
* This role will be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office. However, our agile working policy does allow some home working each week.
* Some international travel may be required.



  





 Walkers global is an equal opportunity employer. Equality and diversity are key to our global identity and an integral part of our goal to continue being an employer of choice. We are committed to a work environment that supports all individuals irrespective of gender, ethnicity, nationality, race, religion, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other applicable legally protected characteristics. We make every effort to ensure that employment opportunities are open and accessible to all purely on the basis of personal ability.

**Job Purpose** 




 The Platform Owner — Cards is accountable for the end‑to‑end run and change lifecycle of RAKBANK’s cards technology platforms, including TSYS Prime 4, TSYS Online Authorization, and post‑facto fraud systems, managing them as a strategic internal bank product. The role ensures platform stability, availability, fraud effectiveness, and API‑driven capability exposure in a millisecond‑critical, scheme‑governed environment, while driving continuous evolution to support new card products, digital wallets, tokenisation, contactless payments, and UAE local and international scheme mandates. Acting as the bank’s primary IT authority for cards, the Platform Owner leads specialist engineering and BA teams and represents the platform in business, scheme, and regulatory engagements, balancing operational excellence with forward‑looking innovation to meet the needs of Personal, SME, Commercial, and Corporate banking segments.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 



* Own the full run‑and‑change lifecycle of RAKBANK’s cards platforms (TSYS Prime 4, Online Authorization, post‑facto fraud), managing them as strategic internal products with defined SLOs, SLAs, and uptime KPIs.
* Ensure full compliance with UAE local payment scheme mandates alongside Visa and Mastercard requirements, managing certifications, timelines, and regulatory obligations.
* Drive platform innovation and future readiness to support new card products, digital wallets, tokenisation, BNPL, and emerging payment capabilities at scale.
* Deliver platform capabilities that meet the full needs of Personal, SME, Commercial, and Corporate banking segments, translating business requirements into robust technology solutions.
* Govern and expose cards capabilities through stable, well‑documented APIs, ensuring versioning discipline and protection for consuming channels and squads.
* Lead high‑precision platform operations, including real‑time authorisation health, BCP/DR readiness, major incident management, and root‑cause elimination.
* Oversee post‑facto fraud detection effectiveness, including rule tuning, performance metrics, and alignment with evolving UAE and regional fraud patterns.
* Manage all platform run activities, including patching, releases, PCI DSS compliance, infrastructure coordination, and scheme certification continuity.
* Lead and develop a high‑performance cards platform team with clear ownership, accountability, and continuous capability building.
* Own and report all run‑and‑change KPIs, technical roadmap, and operational efficiency initiatives, ensuring platform readiness ahead of business and programme demand.



**What You Will Bring:** 



* 15\+ years in banking technology with at least 5 years in a platform management, product ownership, or senior application management role covering card management systems.
* Hands\-on experience with TSYS Prime 4 (or an equivalent enterprise card management platform such as OpenWay WAY4, Compass Plus, or FIS CAMS) is strongly preferred; direct TSYS Prime 4 experience is a significant advantage.
* Deep functional knowledge of card products and operations across the full customer spectrum — consumer credit and debit, prepaid and virtual cards, SME business cards, commercial and large corporate card programmes — and the platform configuration required to support each segment.
* Proven experience managing UAE local payment scheme obligations and mandate delivery — familiarity with Al Etihad Payments, UAESWITCH domestic scheme requirements, and the interoperability framework governing card transactions within the UAE, alongside Visa and Mastercard international scheme management.
* Strong understanding of digital payments innovation — digital wallet integration (Apple Pay, Google Pay), EMV tokenisation, contactless payments, 3DS authentication, open banking card APIs, and BNPL integration.
* Experience managing the post\-facto fraud detection capability — including rule management, fraud analytics, detection effectiveness optimisation, and coordination with fraud operations teams.
* Strong understanding of PCI DSS requirements and their operational implications for card platform management and scheme certification.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Prior experience in the same domain or hands\-on familiarity with the specific technologies relevant to this role will be considered a significant advantage during candidate evaluation.



**Desired Competencies:** 



* Cards platform ownership — TSYS Prime 4, authorisation, and fraud detection lifecycle
* UAE local scheme mandate management alongside Visa and Mastercard obligations
* Cards innovation — digital wallets, tokenisation, virtual cards, and segment\-specific product capability
* Multi\-segment cards domain expertise — personal banking, SME, commercial, and large corporate
* Real\-time authorisation platform operations and SLA/SLO governance
* PCI DSS compliance and scheme certification management
* API governance and stable cards platform interface design
* People leadership and cards technology team development

Our client is a large, well\-established Saudi organization with significant scale across the Kingdom. A confidential search is underway to appoint a
 ****Chief Information Officer****
 who will own the full technology agenda and lead it as a peer to the rest of the executive team.
   

  

 This is a senior executive role with full ownership of the company's technology function. The Chief Information Officer will define and execute the technology strategy across infrastructure, enterprise applications, data, integration, and security, and will be accountable for the reliability, security, and commercial relevance of the entire technology estate.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring a clear point of view on the future state of enterprise technology, the right balance between in\-house capability and strategic partners, and the discipline to deliver value in quarters rather than years.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Duties**
* Define and execute the multi\-year technology strategy across infrastructure, applications, data, integration, and security.
* Set the target architecture for the group, including ERP, core operational systems, data and analytics, and the integration fabric that connects them.
* Make and defend the build, buy, and partner decisions that shape the technology estate.
* Run a modern, reliable enterprise systems environment that supports the core operations of the business.
* Lead any ERP modernization or migration program required to support unified reporting, real\-time decisioning, and operational scale.
* Stand up the integration and middleware capability that allows the core functions to operate from one source of truth.
* Build the data foundation, the warehouse, the governance, and the analytics layer that the commercial, operations, and finance teams need.
* Embed data\-led decision\-making across the senior leadership population.
* Hold full accountability for the cybersecurity posture of the company.
* Ensure full compliance with the National Cybersecurity Authority, the Personal Data Protection Law, and all other applicable regulatory obligations.
* Own business continuity, disaster recovery, and the controls required by internal and external audit.
* Run a service\-oriented IT operation with measurable uptime, response, and cost commitments.
* Lead the program management office for technology, with clear quarterly delivery, transparent governance, and disciplined vendor management.
* Shape the IT operating model, including the balance between in\-house capability, managed services, and strategic partners.
* Sit on the executive committee and act as a peer to the rest of the senior leadership.
* Translate technology into commercial language for the Chief Executive Officer and the board.
* Manage the technology budget with the same rigor as a P\&L, including capital allocation, vendor consolidation, and total cost of ownership.


**Requirements And Qualifications**
* Fifteen years or more in enterprise technology, with at least five at Chief Information Officer, Group CIO, or equivalent level in a complex, multi\-site organization.
* A track record of leading a full technology stack end to end, ideally in a regulated or institutionally governed environment.
* Direct, hands\-on experience with at least one major ERP transformation or core systems re\-platforming program, from business case to go\-live.
* Deep fluency in enterprise technology, including ERP platforms, integration platforms, cloud infrastructure, data and analytics, and modern security architecture.
* Strong commercial instinct, with the ability to challenge and partner with operating leaders rather than simply service them.
* Proven cybersecurity and data privacy leadership at the level expected of a major Saudi organization.
* Vendor management discipline, with a history of consolidating estates, renegotiating contracts, and holding partners to outcomes.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related discipline. Master's degree or MBA is an advantage.
* Relevant certifications in enterprise architecture, security, or program delivery are welcomed.
* Arabic language is an advantage. English is required.

 ****Chief Digital and eCommerce Officer****

The role carries the authority and the accountability to professionalize the digital operating model and to make the online business a genuine, profitable, and brand\-shaping pillar of the company.
   

  

 This is a building role. The product, marketing, fulfillment, and customer functions need to be brought together under one digital leader with the experience to deliver.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Duties**
* Take full ownership of the digital P\&L, including revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, and operating profit across web, app, and any marketplace activity.
* Lead annual planning, monthly forecasting, and the weekly trading rhythm at the standard expected of a serious digital business.
* Own pricing, promotion, and category economics in close partnership with the rest of the leadership.
* Own the digital product roadmap across web and app, with a clear, customer\-led prioritization framework.
* Build the in\-house product, design, and engineering capability required to operate a modern, conversion\-optimized digital storefront.
* Lead the technology choices that support the online business, in partnership with the broader technology function.
* Run the online trading operation, including range visibility, search relevance, recommendations, and promotional planning.
* Develop the marketplace and partner strategy where appropriate.
* Ensure the online proposition is coherent and commercially optimized.
* Own the digital customer P\&L, including acquisition, retention, lifetime value, and reactivation.
* Lead performance marketing, SEO, CRM, lifecycle marketing, and loyalty.
* Build the data, personalization, and segmentation engine that turns a single view of the customer into measurable commercial impact.
* Lead the fulfillment and last\-mile strategy, including the right balance of own and third\-party logistics.
* Own the post\-purchase experience end to end, from order confirmation to delivery, returns, and after\-sales support.
* Set the standard for digital customer experience across all touchpoints.
* Sit on the executive committee as the voice of the customer and the online business.
* Represent the digital agenda to the Chief Executive Officer and the board.
* Build a digitally fluent, commercially disciplined team with strong representation of Saudi national talent.


**Requirements And Qualifications**
* Twelve to eighteen years in eCommerce, digital, or direct\-to\-consumer leadership, with at least five years owning a meaningful online P\&L.
* A demonstrable track record of taking a digital channel from low single\-digit to material double\-digit share of group revenue, profitably.
* Experience leading a digital function during a period of structural change, including operating model, talent, and platform decisions.
* Strong commercial instinct, comfortable owning gross margin, contribution margin, and operating profit, not only top\-line growth.
* Fluent in modern digital architecture, including headless commerce, composable platforms, search and personalization, app development, and CDP and CRM tooling.
* Sharp on performance marketing economics, lifetime value modeling, and the unit economics of last\-mile delivery.
* Confident with marketplace dynamics and third\-party seller models where relevant.
* Direct, data\-led, and unafraid to make trade\-offs in pricing, range, and investment.
* Bachelor's degree in business, economics, engineering, or a related discipline. Master's degree or MBA is an advantage.
* Arabic language is an advantage. English is required.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is a senior leadership position that transcends traditional pharmacovigilance, sitting at the heart of regulatory trust, clinical practice, and patient outcomes.

* Drive Innovation: Move beyond compliance\-only models toward integrated safety risk management that directly impacts clinical practice and patient care
* Influence Externally: Represent Roche in key regulatory and industry forums, strengthening our position as a trusted partner with health authorities
* Empower Talent: Lead and mentor a high\-performing team of safety professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and cross\-functional collaboration
* Simplify \& Optimize: Contribute regional insights to evolve Roche's global safety systems, balancing global consistency with essential local relevance

* You are a visionary leader who thrives in complex, evolving environments and possesses the strategic mindset needed to translate safety insights into meaningful patient impact. You are a collaborator at heart, capable of influencing senior stakeholders and health authorities
* Experienced Leader: You bring significant leadership experience in Patient Safety, Pharmacovigilance, or Regulatory Affairs, with a proven track record of managing regional or complex cross\-country teams
* Strategic Navigator: You have a deep understanding of healthcare systems within the GCC; experience navigating the regulatory landscape in Saudi Arabia is highly valued
* Relationship Builder: You excel at engaging with external stakeholders and health authorities to build long\-term regulatory confidence
* Transformation Catalyst: You are comfortable driving change, building team capabilities beyond traditional compliance, and integrating safety into broader clinical and medical decision\-making
* Effective Communicator: You possess strong executive presence and the ability to communicate complex safety strategies to diverse audiences


**Ready to make a difference?**
 Together, we'll create a healthier, brighter future for all. Apply today to help us shape the future of patient safety in the GCC.
   

  

 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate.  Let’s build a healthier future, together.

data.jd_text:
**About Us**
 Tamara is the leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC region with a mission to help people make their dreams come true by building the most customer\-centric financial super\-app on earth. The company serves millions of users in KSA, UAE and Kuwait, and partners with leading global and regional brands such as SHEIN, Jarir, noon, Amazon, IKEA, eXtra and Farfetch as well as small and medium businesses.
   

  

 Tamara is Saudi’s first fintech unicorn and is backed by Sanabil Investments, SNB Capital, Checkout.com, amongst others, operating out of its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia with other regional and global support offices.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a startup\-within\-a\-startup role. You will be responsible for building a net new banking product from scratch for the Saudi Arabia market — from ideation through design and launch.
   

  

 This role is high ambiguity, high complexity, and requires someone who thrives in uncharted territory. There is no playbook — you will write it. You must be comfortable navigating ambiguity, making tactical trade\-offs, and moving with execution velocity.
   

  

 As Product Manager, you will own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle of a new fintech product that will advance how merchants at Tamara manage their money. You will work daily with a full\-stack team — engineers, product designers, researchers, data analysts, operations, and business stakeholders — to ship an innovative and incredible experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the execution, vision \& strategy for a net new fintech vertical.
* Work with engineers, designers, data scientists, and commercial teams to drive the roadmap for a net\-new product.
* Be technically competent enough to be able to decide on the execution plan while managing several internal technical dependencies.
* Deeply understand the KSA Fintech ecosystem, compliance rules \& regulations — and understand how it may impact your roadmap.
* Deeply understand the operational impacts of the products we are releasing \& work with risk, compliance, treasury, customer support and others to ensure product success.
* Prototype rapidly using tools like Cursor, Claude \& Codex to accelerate product development work.
* Contribute to commercial planning \& GTM of the product and own the outcomes.
* Lead a core team of engineers \& designers and drive the end to end execution forward.
* Contribute to the evolution of Tamara’s Product Management practices as AI scales our work.


**Qualifications**
* You have 4\+ years of Product Management experience, with proven experience building 0—\>1 products that have shipped and scaled.
* You have worked with early stage product teams or startups and have successfully taken a product from concept to launch.
* You have strong UX taste — you care deeply about the end\-to\-end customer experience and can hold a high bar for product quality.
* You have experience working on complex, multi\-surface products with a large blast radius of impact.
* You are a strong collaborator who works effectively with engineering, design, data, and operations teams on a daily basis.
* You are data\-driven — you have strong analytical skills, are comfortable with experimentation, and can use data to inform decisions and measure outcomes.
* You are able to think from first principles, break down complex problems, and navigate ambiguity with confidence.
* You have strong business acumen — you understand unit economics, business models, and can make decisions that balance customer value with business outcomes.
* You understand regulatory requirements and operational considerations that come with building financial products.
* You are customer\-obsessed — you aren’t shy about getting on calls with merchants, visiting them, and deeply understanding their needs.
* FinTech experience — you have worked on financial products before and understand the nuances of payments, banking, lending, or adjacent spaces.
* Must have the ability to use AI in their day to day to work. Preferred experience working in high\-growth companies.
* Arabic speaking is required for this role — you will work closely with merchants and stakeholders in KSA.


 All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

**Company Description**
*We’re* 
*Checkout.com* 
*. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.*
*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions daily for more than one billion global shoppers.*
*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*
*If you want to do career\-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*
**The Role**
 Checkout.com is seeking a talented Senior Financial Partnerships Specialist in Riyadh to join the adventure and support our rapid growth and expansion in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 Working with a regional team, your main responsibility will be to manage and grow our partnerships with Acquiring Banks, APMs and card networks such as Visa, Mastercard and MADA. You will contribute to the development and execution of our strategy for such partnerships.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Financial Partnerships \- MENA, the successful candidate will be able to handle multiple projects and partnerships autonomously, have sufficient payments knowledge and experience to do so, and have a hands\-on approach necessary in a fast growing start\-up like ours. This is a great opportunity to contribute, learn and grow working on a broad range of projects in building a world\-class payments infrastructure.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Manage commercial relationships with Acquiring Banks, APMs and grow Card Networks (including MADA) to develop and deliver market leading payment solutions for our merchants.
* Drive expansion projects as required across geographies and payment methods in collaboration with a wider team.
* Negotiate the most favorable operational and commercial outcomes for Checkout.com while balancing internal and external stakeholders
* Ensure existing processes are followed and deliverables are met by both sides in a partnership. Design and develop new processes to scale those partnerships for growth, efficiency and performance improvement.
* Collaborate effectively with various functions in the partner organization such as relationship management, business development, risk, compliance, product and operations across all levels.
* Develop and execute a best\-in\-class partnership management model. Be the single point of contact internally and externally for assigned partnerships.
* Use payments industry knowledge and experience to develop and execute strategies to support our growth with new products, services and market segments through partnerships.
* Craft and implement win\-win commercial agreements and go\-to\-market strategies with payment partners.
* Leverage knowledge about the payments industry and partners’ capabilities to act as subject matter experts for internal teams.


**Qualifications**
* At least 3 years experience in payments.
* Direct experience in payment processing, acquiring, or managing payment partnerships.
* Proficient in payments knowledge, with the ability to problem solve or identify potential blockers within the payment flow and communicate these problems effectively to the wider teams.
* Experience working with card networks or PSPs for acquiring payment transactions is a strong plus.
* A mix of operations, project management, and relationship management skill set.
* A strong sense of ownership to deliver business results with a focus on managing partner relationships.
* Arabic speaking is MANDATORY for this role due to the relationships with local partners
* Strong collaborator and communicator with the ability to influence stakeholders across organizations internally and externally.
* Data\-driven, analytical and strategic in problem solving issues and identifying opportunities to drive growth and efficiency.
* Comfortable working across time zones and cultures in a globally distributed team.


**Additional Information**
**Bring all of you to work**
 We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.
   

  

 Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.
   

  

 We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.
   

  

 It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.
   

  

**Life at** 
**Checkout.com**
 We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.
   

  

 Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.
   

  

 For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

* Align SAP payment processes with finance and treasury policies
* Document configurations, support training, and handle post\-go\-live support
