data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Tiered Approach**
 In Line With The Commitment To Safeguard Capacity And Support Personnel Already In The Organization, a Majority Of UNDP UNCDF/UNV Vacancies Are Advertised Using a Tiered Application Process Whereby
   

  

* Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026\.
* Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments
* Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates


 Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.
   

  

**Background**
 The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) Country Office in the Kingdom of Bahrain operates within the context of a high\-income, net\-contributing country, where UNDP engagement is fully funded through government cost\-sharing and aligned with national development priorities. Bahrain is implementing an ambitious national reform agenda under Bahrain Vision 2030 and the Government Programme (2023–2026\), with a strong focus on economic diversification, fiscal sustainability, effective governance, environmental resilience, digital transformation, and inclusive human development. As a net contributor country, UNDP Bahrain maintains a lean operational footprint while delivering high\-value technical assistance, policy advisory services, and innovation\-driven solutions in support of national priorities.
   

  

 UNDP Bahrain’s programme is guided by the Country Programme Document (CPD) 2025–2029, approved by the UNDP Executive Board in January 2025, and is fully aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2025–2029\. The financial envelope for the 2025–2029 Country Programme Document (CPD) is structured around a total estimated cost of US 2\.5 million for Economic Prosperity (Outcome 1\) and US 5 million for Environmental Sustainability (Outcome 3\). As of late 2025, the Country Office manages seven ongoing projects with a total remaining budget of approximately US$ 1\.8 million. These initiatives are distributed across the three CPD outcomes: Outcome 1 (Economic Prosperity) and Outcome 3 (Environmental Sustainability) each account for about 37–38% of the project count, while Outcome 2 (Governance) makes up the remaining 25%. Notable projects Youth Leadership Program, King Hanad Ward for SDGs, National Human Development Report in partnership with DERASAT. A new generation of projects is expected to be developed under this Outcome.
   

  

 The CPD Positions UNDP As a Trusted Strategic Partner To The Government Of Bahrain, Contributing To UNSDCF Outcomes Through Integrated, Multi\-sectoral Interventions That Address Complex Development Challenges At The Intersection Of Economic Prosperity, Governance And Human Rights, And Environmental Sustainability. Under The Country Programme Document (CPD) 2025–2029, UNDP Bahrain’s Engagement Is Structured Around Three Interrelated CPD Pillars
   

  

 (i) Economic prosperity and sustainable livelihoods;
   

  

 (ii) Effective governance, human rights, and access to justice; and
   

  

 (iii) Environmental sustainability and climate resilience.
   

  

 These pillars reflect national priorities under Bahrain Vision 2030 and the Government Programme (2023–2026\), and constitute UNDP’s substantive contribution to the implementation of the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2025–2029\.
   

  

 To ensure coherence, integration, and efficient delivery within a lean Country Office structure, the Bahrain CO operationalizes the three CPD pillars through two integrated programme clusters. The first cluster brings together
 **economic transformation, sustainable livelihoods, and environmental sustainability** 
 , The second cluster focuses on
 **governance, human rights, access to justice, and social inclusion** 
 .
   

  

 This two\-cluster delivery model enables the Country Office to manage complexity, promote synergies across CPD pillars, and apply a portfolio approach to programme design, implementation, and partnerships. Staff are therefore expected to work across thematic boundaries, contribute to integrated solutions, and support joint programming within the UN system, while ensuring results\-based management, quality assurance, and alignment with national and UNSDCF priorities.
   

  

 Under the direct supervision of the Transition Manager (P4\) and overall guidance of the Resident Representative and in close collaboration with the rest of the Country Office programme team, the Programme Analyst \- Governance, Human Rights and Social Inclusion (GHRSI) will manage the oversight, accountability, and coordination of this programme area.
   

  

**The Programme Analyst Is Therefore Entrusted With**
* Contributing to setting the strategic direction of the area and the overarching UNDP Country Office programme as it related to this thematic area.
* Aiding in the management and coordination of the programme portfolio and team.
* Forging and growing broad\-based strategic partnerships, support to resource mobilization and strategic expansion.
* Provision of quality policy advice services to the Government and other relevant stakeholders, and facilitation of dynamic learning and knowledge that informs strategic programming and fuels programmatic impact.


 The
 **Programme Analyst** 
 leads the Governance, Human Rights, and Social Inclusion cluster, providing strategic oversight and leadership to strengthen Bahrain's governance systems and rule of law. The role focuses on capacity building for judiciary and law enforcement, promoting gender equality. Additionally, the Analyst is responsible for fostering civic participation platforms for youth and women, managing partnerships with civil society and academia, and driving
 **resource mobilization** 
 to ensure the portfolio's long\-term sustainability.
   

  

 S/he endeavors to integrate the GHRSI cluster with the Economic Prosperity and Environment unit by fostering institutional innovation and evidence\-based public sector management to support a responsive digital economy. This cross\-cutting collaboration focuses on aligning digital transformation policies with international human rights standards and inclusive participation frameworks. Together, both clusters leverage data\-driven policy and statistical capacity building to ensure that innovation pipelines remain equitable and leave no one behind
   

  

 The incumbent also works in strong collaboration with the Regional Hub in Amman, as well as other regional and global UNDP Hubs, and professional and knowledge networks.
   

  

 UNDP personnel are expected to embrace innovative thinking and work across units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams that actively connect knowledge and skills around issues to ensure higher programmatic coherence and drive transformative changes.
   

  

 The incumbent is expected to display innovation, problem solving, trouble shooting, active initiative, and a strong client orientation that encourages and rewards excellence in programme delivery and implementation. S/he might be required to undertake emerging tasks and additional duties as requested by senior management.
   

  

 UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams in order to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
* Substantively contribute to formulation and implementation of UNDP programme strategies and policies on Governance, Human Rights, Social Inclusion:
* Contribute to analysis of the political, social and economic situation in the country; and contribute collaborative inputs to the UN Common Country Assessment and Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNCCA and UNSDCF) as well as to the preparation/revision of the Country Programme Document (CPD), Integrated Work Plan (IWP) and other strategic documents.
* Contribute to operationalizing UNSDCF/ CPD in collaboration with the main partners and other UN Agencies.
* Ensure implementation of relevant programme Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure the effectiveness of CO business processes.
* Analyze and synthesize proposals in assigned programme areas.
* Provides input into the integrated design of new development interventions (e.g., projects, etc.).
* Liaises with national and international partners, etc. in strategic programme areas of cooperation.
* Engages with colleagues in the Amman Regional Hub and Headquarters to apply in country programming new global and regional initiatives, polices and knowledge products that further the Governance, Human Rights and Social Inclusion programme.
* Ensure effective management of the CO programme within the assigned thematic/sector areas focusing on quality assurance and risk management from formulation to implementation of the country programme:
* Contribute to design and formulation of CO programme, translate UNDP priorities into local interventions, and oversee programme implementation with the implementing partners within the assigned programme areas. Ensure that design and formulation of programme considers societal digital technology risks and opportunities and other future signals.
* Oversee planning, budgeting, implementation and monitoring of the assigned programme areas; and track use of financial resources in accordance with UNDP rules and regulations. Ensure digital technology solutions in programme implementation are managed towards scalability and sustainability in line with UNDP’s digital standards.
* Ensure effective application of results\-based management tools and track achievement of strategic results.
* Ensure the effective use of data in programme implementation, across the data lifecycle; and ensure effective monitoring, evaluation and learning on programme impact.

We are building a next‑generation private equity platform in Bahrain and are looking for a senior AI leader to embed advanced analytics and GenAI across the full investment lifecycle. This is a hands‑on, high‑visibility role working directly with the investment team and portfolio leadership to turn AI into tangible value creation.

* Shape and own the AI strategy across deal sourcing, screening, diligence, IC, portfolio monitoring and exits.

* Drive firm‑wide adoption through training, playbooks, proof‑of‑concepts and LP‑facing narratives that highlight the firm’s digital edge.

* Strong understanding of the private equity lifecycle, IC standards and value creation frameworks – you can translate AI into IRR and MOIC impact.
* Evidence of deploying AI solutions in institutional or regulated environments with robust data privacy and model‑risk practices.

**Why this platform** 




  




* Join a Manama‑headquartered financial group with a growing alternatives and private equity footprint across the GCC and global markets.
* Work at the intersection of AI and private equity in one of the GCC’s most established financial centres, with direct exposure to senior leadership and portfolio C‑suites.

 As a Business Director, you’ll lead and grow our senior client relationships in Kuwait, working with leading regional and multinational clients across the GCC. * AI \& Tech Focus: A specific passion for emerging AI\-driven tools and their application in the evolving digital landscape.

 Citi was amongst the first foreign banks to establish presence on the ground in Kuwait in 2006, with deep routed relationships with the state dating back to the 1950s. The business in Kuwait is an Institutional Clients Group (ICG) franchise supported by circa 35 employees in country. The business activity covers the Public Sector, Private Sector, and Financial institutions with well\-developed client relationships.
   

  

 The Citi franchise in Kuwait will be part of the newly formed Middle East and Pakistan Sub\-Cluster. This new Sub\-Cluster is positioned to cover a geography with significant wealth and appetite for investments locally and globally. The Kuwait CCO \& BH, along with the rest of the Middle East and Pakistan Sub\-Cluster CCOs, will report directly to Middle East and Pakistan Sub\-Cluster Head.
   

  

 The Citi Country Officer \& Banking Head is the face of Citi in the country, playing the crucial role of leading and protecting the Citi franchise. In both leading the business and protecting the franchise, the CCO \& BH must achieve collaboration and alignment across all stakeholders – effectively managing a large matrix team.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Franchise Management in terms of developing and executing Citi’s overall client’s and business strategy to achieve both short and long\- term goals in compliance with corporate standards and local regulations.
* Ensuring compliance with all corporate policies, including ethical standards, corporate governance standards and business practice requirements.
* Applying judgment in understanding issues and making sound decisions that support, confirm, and enhance Citi's mission and vision.
* Identifying, assessing, mitigating, communicating, and anticipating all types of risks through the development and sustainability of appropriate control mechanisms.
* Overseeing, and escalating as necessary, the resourcing requirements of the legal entity to perform its governance, risk management and compliance obligations and reporting material risks / issues affecting the legal entity to the appropriate governance committees.
* Exhibit efficient and effective leadership that touches all parts of the franchise and provides a strong role model.
* Ability to attain and maintain strong relationship management with clients, government officials, regulators, employees, and media that engender a high level of trust and transparency to support the development of Citi’s market position and growth.
* In partnership with HR, executing Citi’s Talent agenda and overseeing franchise\-wide Talent review and development activities.
* Sponsor employee engagement across the franchise ensuring employees at all levels are engaged, productive and effective.
* Leading Citi’s response to a franchise\-wide event, e.g. crisis or disaster.
* Protecting Citi’s reputation in the country.
* Managing (directly or through matrix reporting, as appropriate) all businesses, product lines and functions based in country.
* Managing the organization and corporate governance of country\-based legal entities and their regulatory reporting.
* Leading management and coordination of governmental and regulatory relationships.
* Providing oversight for all critical country and other risk limits and for country scenario planning.
* Ensuring compliance with all applicable requirements regarding financial inclusion.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behaviour, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.
* Other job\-related duties may be assigned as required.
* Develop and monitor a client\-driven franchise growth strategy which is delivered through people and franchise management.
* Oversight of Citi’s Banking organization. The unified Banking \& International organization oversees the local delivery of the full firm to clients in each of the markets where Citi has onshore presence.
* Responsible for the Kuwait Banking P\&L. The role will have responsibility for both flow and episodic revenue which requires strong leadership, risk skills, corporate finance mindset and partnerships to deliver best in class solutions.
* Drive innovation and speed to market and promote cross\-selling of products across the full platform.
* Responsible for overall parent relationship management of clients and providing a wide range of treasury and corporate finance solutions, including cash management, trade, vendor finance, FX, general credit, loans, debt capital markets, share repurchase, and interest rate and equity derivatives.
* Ensuring efficient use of Capital and that Capital returns (RORC and RoTCE) are delivered across the franchise.
* Responsible for meeting revenue goals and other goals related to budget, risk management, and credit allocation in partnership with GCM and Risk.
* Lead the Sustainability agenda and the digital transformation for clients with particular emphasis on digital natives and digital tools.

**Position Overview**
 Product Engineering Head Job Description
   

  

 We are seeking a Product Engineering Head to lead the engineering organization responsible for building, scaling, and evolving our core products. This role represents the senior engineering leader who translates product vision into technical reality, working in close partnership with the Product Management team to deliver innovative Decision Intelligence solutions to market.
   

  

 You will own the complete engineering delivery of our product roadmap — from architecture and technical design through implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement. Leading a cross\-functional engineering organization (backend, frontend, data/ML, DevOps, QA), you will build world\-class product engineering capabilities that enable rapid innovation, exceptional user experiences, and enterprise\-grade reliability at scale. Your focus is building standardized, multi\-tenant and AI agents that serve many customers, as opposed to one\-off customized solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Product\-Engineering Partnership \& Strategy
   

  

* Partner closely with the Product Management team as the senior engineering leader to translate product vision, strategy, and roadmap into executable engineering plans and deliverables.
* Participate in product strategy discussions, roadmap planning sessions, and product prioritization decisions providing technical perspective on feasibility, effort, trade\-offs, and innovation opportunities.
* Collaborate with Product Management to define product requirements, acceptance criteria, and success metrics ensuring shared understanding between product vision and engineering execution.
* Provide technical input and engineering perspective during product discovery, user research synthesis, and feature conceptualization helping shape product decisions with engineering insights on what's possible, scalable, and innovative.
* Balance product ambition with engineering pragmatism identifying opportunities to deliver breakthrough user value while managing technical complexity, debt, and platform stability.
* Champion engineering excellence and platform thinking in product discussions ensuring product decisions consider long\-term architectural health, technical debt management, scalability requirements, and engineering sustainability.


 Platform Architecture \& Technical Leadership
   

  

* Own the technical architecture and platform strategy for all products and AI agents ensuring scalable, secure, maintainable, and performant multi\-tenant systems.
* Define and drive the evolution of core platform capabilities, shared services, component libraries, design systems, and engineering infrastructure that accelerate product development velocity.
* Make critical architectural decisions on technology choices, system design patterns, data architecture, API contracts, integration strategies, and infrastructure approaches balancing innovation, proven technologies, and team capabilities.
* Establish and maintain engineering standards, architectural principles, design patterns, security guidelines, and quality benchmarks that ensure consistency and excellence across the product engineering organization.
* Drive technical innovation in AI/ML model deployment, real\-time data processing, intelligent automation, and Decision Intelligence capabilities that differentiate our products in the market.
* Lead architectural reviews, technology evaluations, and technical risk assessments providing oversight and guidance on major technical decisions across product engineering teams.
* Proactively manage technical debt balancing the need to move fast on product roadmap with maintaining high code quality, system reliability, and long\-term platform health.


 Engineering Delivery \& Execution Excellence
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end engineering delivery of product roadmap translating product requirements into technical specifications, breaking down complex features, and driving execution across engineering teams.
* Establish and continuously improve engineering processes, development workflows, sprint ceremonies, code review practices, testing strategies, and deployment pipelines that maximize team velocity and product quality.
* Drive predictable, high\-velocity product delivery ensuring engineering teams consistently ship high\-quality features on schedule that meet product requirements and delight users.
* Monitor and optimize engineering velocity, deployment frequency, lead time, mean time to recovery (MTTR), and other key engineering performance metrics identifying bottlenecks and driving continuous improvement.
* Coordinate closely with Data Science/ML teams to integrate AI models, intelligent features, and decision support capabilities into products ensuring seamless collaboration between research and production engineering.
* Establish robust quality assurance practices including automated testing (unit, integration, end\-to\-end), performance testing, security testing, and user acceptance testing that ensure product excellence.
* Drive DevOps excellence and production reliability ensuring systems achieve enterprise\-grade uptime, performance, scalability, security, and observability through robust SRE practices.
* Lead incident response, post\-mortem analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives — building a culture of operational excellence, learning from failures, and proactively preventing issues.


 Organization Leadership \& Team Development
   

  

* Build, lead, and scale a world\-class product engineering organization across multiple disciplines: backend engineering, frontend/UI engineering, data/ML engineering, DevOps/SRE, and quality engineering.
* Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent establishing the company as a destination for top engineers seeking challenging product problems, cutting\-edge technology, and career growth.
* Develop engineering leaders within the organization mentoring engineering managers, tech leads, and senior engineers to grow their technical, leadership, and product thinking capabilities.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and customer obsession throughout the product engineering organization.
* Establish clear engineering career progression frameworks, competency expectations, performance standards, and growth pathways that enable engineers to advance their careers.
* Drive organizational effectiveness through appropriate team structures, clear ownership models, effective communication practices, and efficient decision\-making processes.
* Ensure high team engagement, satisfaction, and retention through regular 1\-on\-1s, team feedback sessions, recognition programs, growth opportunities, and addressing concerns proactively.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Collaborate effectively with Product Design team to ensure engineering feasibility, implementation quality, and technical innovation support excellent user experiences and design vision.
* Partner with Revenue/Sales teams to understand customer needs, support product demonstrations, provide technical insights for customer conversations, and ensure delivered products meet market requirements.
* Work closely with Customer Success and Support teams to understand customer pain points, prioritize bug fixes, improve product quality, and ensure exceptional customer experiences.
* Coordinate with Solution Engineering team to leverage shared platform capabilities, provide technical guidance for customization requirements, and identify opportunities to productize common client needs.
* Communicate engineering progress, technical challenges, resource needs, and strategic initiatives effectively to the CTO, executive team, and board providing transparency and building stakeholder confidence.
* Report regularly to the CTO on product engineering performance, team health, technical strategy execution, platform evolution, and organizational capability development.


**Requirements**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience demonstrating deep technical expertise and leadership capability.


**Experience**
* 8\+ years in software engineering with proven track record building and scaling SAAS products, including at least 3 years in senior engineering leadership roles managing multi\-disciplinary engineering organizations.
* Demonstrated success leading product engineering teams that ship high\-quality, customer\-facing products at scale with measurable impact on business growth, user satisfaction, and product\-market fit.
* Deep experience building multi\-tenant SAAS platforms and cloud\-native applications that serve enterprise customers with requirements for security, reliability, performance, and scalability.
* Proven track record of effective Product\-Engineering partnership working collaboratively with Product Management, Product Design, and business stakeholders to deliver products that achieve strategic objectives.
* Experience leading engineering teams through significant growth phases scaling team size, improving engineering velocity, establishing best practices, and maintaining culture during periods of rapid expansion.
* Strong background in AI/ML product development, data\-intensive applications, or intelligent systems with ability to bridge ML research and production engineering effectively.
* Track record of building high\-performing engineering cultures characterized by technical excellence, innovation, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


 Technical Expertise
   

  

* Deep expertise in modern software architecture patterns: microservices, event\-driven architectures, API\-first design, CQRS, domain\-driven design, and distributed systems principles.
* Strong understanding of full\-stack product development: backend services, frontend frameworks, mobile applications, data pipelines, ML model deployment, and infrastructure automation.
* Extensive experience with cloud platforms (GCP strongly preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable) including platform services, infrastructure\-as\-code, container orchestration, serverless computing, and managed services.
* Expertise in building scalable data architectures: real\-time streaming, batch processing, data warehousing, data lakes, feature stores, and analytics platforms supporting AI/ML workloads.
* Deep understanding of AI/ML engineering: model serving, A/B testing, feature engineering, ML pipelines, monitoring/observability for ML systems, and MLOps best practices.
* Strong knowledge of modern frontend technologies and frameworks (React, Vue, Angular, or similar), responsive design, progressive web applications, and mobile development approaches.
* Expertise in DevOps and SRE practices: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, monitoring and observability, incident management, capacity planning, and production reliability engineering.
* Comprehensive understanding of security and compliance: authentication/authorization, data encryption, secure coding practices, vulnerability management, compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR), and security architecture.
* Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices: code review, testing strategies (unit, integration, E2E), refactoring, technical debt management, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* Experience with agile/lean development methodologies, product development frameworks, sprint planning, velocity optimization, and iterative delivery approaches.


 Leadership \& Professional Skills
   

  

* Exceptional leadership and people management capabilities able to inspire, align, develop, and retain world\-class engineering talent while building positive, high\-performance team cultures.
* Outstanding communication skills with ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences including product managers, designers, executives, board members, and customers.
* Strong product thinking and business acumen understanding how engineering decisions impact user experience, product\-market fit, competitive positioning, business metrics, and company strategy.
* Strategic mindset combined with execution excellence able to think long\-term about platform evolution, technical strategy, and organizational capability while delivering immediate product roadmap commitments.
* Collaborative leadership style with demonstrated ability to build strong cross\-functional partnerships with Product, Design, Revenue, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders.
* Data\-driven decision\-making approach leveraging metrics, user feedback, system telemetry, and experimentation to make informed engineering and product decisions.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills with ability to navigate ambiguity, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and adapt strategy based on learning.
* Growth mindset and commitment to continuous learning staying current with emerging technologies, industry trends, engineering practices, and product development innovations.
* Passionate about building products that solve real customer problems, deliver exceptional user experiences, and create meaningful business impact.
* High integrity and strong values committed to ethical engineering practices, inclusive team culture, transparent communication, and doing what's right for customers and the company.

**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a role that will help you stand out at HSBC, take a look at how you can fulfil your potential.
   

  

 HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) is an emerging markets\-led, financing\-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long\-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
   

  

 Credit \& Capital Management Services (CCMS) under CIB are in the process of implementing a new, modern, and consistent E2E operating model. A key component of this operating model is the introduction of a first line credit management office, the Business Credit Office (BCO). The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and docs negotiation with WCMR and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all Credit \& Lending (C\&L) tasks, creating a single control point. The function will be client facing and customer service orientated.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are currently seeking a high caliber professional to join our team as a Country Head of CCM Services \& Lead BCO.
   

  

**In This Role You Will Be Responsilbe For**
* Ensuring CCM OKRs are achieved for their respective market
* Leading the execution and implementation of the BCO function, to efficiently manage the underwriting process across country CIB. The BCO function to be globally leading across the bank, leveraging organizational design capabilities to optimize processes and structures.
* Taking a lead in managing the portfolio and risk exposure partnering with banking teams and WCRM to determine and monitor risk appetite
* Driving policy and procedure simplification / optimization to make the underwriting process more effective with a focus on value\-add activities and creating risk differentiated processes
* Continuously focus on improving the productivity of the function whilst enhancing client experience
* Providing oversight to outsourced credit \& capital management services
* Landing an ambitious multi\-year transformation journey within their market
* Implementing the Target CCM Services Operating Model and delivering financial targets associated with its’ implementation in the market
* Leading risk and control management across the end\-to\-end process
* Manage CCM COO FRP, budgeting and planning processes for the market
* Land locally the transformation and digitisation of the CCM COO journey and lead local initiatives to improve and re\-engineer processes for the market
* Monitor and analyse customer feedback, identifying key areas of focus to significantly improve customer outcomes for the market
* Represent CCM Services in front of market stakeholders and at market forum
* Unify and provide direction to a dislocated set of smaller teams, fostering a sense of unity and purpose and embed the Target CCM services operating model
* Develop and maintain a diverse, innovation\-driven credit and lending workforce, ensuring high levels of engagement and satisfaction.
* Oversee and execute the delivery of CCM services in\-country (where required), ensuring alignment with regional processes and a seamless and efficient process for customers
* Monitor and analyse customer feedback within the market, identifying local areas of focus to improve customer outcomes while ensuring alignment with regional and global priorities.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders, including technology, CCM, WCRM, Legal, the global business Coverage teams, digital channels and products to implement the overall strategy for the wholesale credit and lending journey.
* Implement governance frameworks to ensure risks and issues related to the Credit \& Lending journey are escalated to regional, and global stakeholders and resolved in a satisfactory manner. Monitor the management of financial and non\-financial risks pertaining to the CCM production in partnership with local NFR/Business Risk.
* Act as the local Business Service Owner for Credit \& Lending across CIB, ensuring service resilience. Manage and execute local end\-to\-end processes for Credit \& Lending on behalf of the CIB Business. Monitor and manage local risk and controls across the end\-to\-end controls, meeting all SOX obligations.
* Support the OKR, KPI and SLA management framework within the market, maintaining service management oversight pertaining to both operational and control performance across all CCM CTB \& RTB services end\-to\-end.
* Collaborate with the CCMS Product, Design and Innovation Pillar, technology and transformation teams to execute the technology strategy for CCM, reduce legacy technologies, and drive a culture of innovation by developing cutting\-edge automation, capability, and business solutions leveraging next\-gen technologies, AI, and analytics.
* Manage multiple senior stakeholders with varied and sometimes conflicting agendas, effectively navigating complex situations and driving alignment.
* Maintain a diverse, innovation\-driven credit and lending workforce, ensuring high levels of engagement and satisfaction.


**To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:**
* Extensive years of experience in wholesale credit and lending, with a strong background in coverage, credit management or operations
* Proven track record of leading and managing teams, with experience in organizational design and strategic planning.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders.
* Expertise in credit risk management, control assessment, and SOX compliance.
* Experience in driving digitisation and customer experience improvement initiatives.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to consume large volumes of customer feedback and distil key areas of focus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.
* Great team player with a positive attitude, energy and enthusiasm.
* Promote a collective culture to spread experience and best practice and live the Group Values.
* Give timely, honest and constructive feedback to others.
* Promotes innovative and lateral thinking approach for devising solutions.
* Bring thought leadership and governance around the internal and external lending ecosystem.
* Deliver fair outcome for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets.
* Highly effective communication skills (oral, written and presentational)
* Ability to work accurately and achieve tight deadlines with limited supervision
* Self\-motivation, and a proven rapid learning capability in a changing environment are essential
* Committed to personal and professional development


 You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
   

  

 We believe diversity brings benefits for our customers, our business and our people. Different ideas and perspectives help us innovate, manage risk and grow the business in a sustainable way. data.jd_text:
Incumbent is expected to lead the global coordination of ESG \& Climate risk related governance, policy universe, regulatory reporting, gap analysis \& remediation against various home and host country regulations. Incumbent will be responsible for management of all classes of risks for Mashreq Bahrain in coordination with HO Risk (retail and wholesale branch). Incumbent is expected to meet all regulatory and management\-related expectations on risk management in coordination with Central Functions in Head Office.
 



  





**Global Head of ESG Risks** 



* Development, maintenance and implementation of group wide ESG \& climate risk related policy universe. e.g. Climate Risk Policy, ESG Risk policy, Inputs to other risk management policy universe for embedding ESG risk into policy universe in coordination with other relevant stakeholders.
* Ensuring inputs required from Risk management for all disclosures related to, Net zero, Transition planning etc. are fulfilled and coordinated.
* Focal point of coordination for ESG Risks related matters across Mashreq Group supporting country risk managers for coordination and management of ESG risks across Mashreq’s Presence countries overseas including escalation, alignment, and best‑practice sharing.
* Establishing ESG risks related roles and responsibilities across the organization via appropriate governance of ESG risk at the relevant management committees, forums, workshops, conferences and other events in areas of ESG \& climate risk. e.g. Group Risk committee, BRCESGC, IBG ESG Committee, ESG Committee, Sustainability Executive committee etc.
* Conducting gap analysis, roadmaps and remediation plans for various ESG \& climate risk related regulatory guidelines and associated regulatory submissions e.g. CB UAE climate risk principles and regulation.
* Ownership of ESG risk measurement oversight and ensuring compliance with all internal policies and procedures
* Change management for ESG \& climate risk related initiatives and automation projects in coordination with ESG team, One Data \& Technology, External consultants and other stakeholders across three lines of defense while ensuring compliance with data governance standards and coordination with enterprise data teams and designated data champions.
* Supporting the development and enhancement of various regulatory reporting disclosures like GRI, ESG Reporting, ISSB, IFRS S1 and S2, Pillar 3 disclosures etc. with ESG \& climate related financial risks inputs across home and host countries regulations.
* Supporting the internal \& external capacity building initiatives via training and awareness around ESG \& climate risk



  





**Chief Risk Officer Bahrain** 



* Country Risk Manager Bahrain will be a regulatory function responsible for coordination \& management of governance of all risk classes for Mashreq Bahrain in coordination with HO Risk
* Act as credit risk management local coordinator for the outsourced element to head office credit management group
* The incumbent will act as a secretary of Bahrain Risk Committee and will be focal point of coordination for day\-to\-day coordination around management of all risk classes in coordination with HO Risk. Management of Bahrain Risk Committee, Charter/TOR, minutes of meeting.
* Implementation of International Risk Management framework for Mashreq Bahrain. Maintenance, reporting \& monitoring of Level 3 Country Risk Appetite for Bahrain
* Responsible for maintenance of Local risk management related policy \& process notes \& CORR and handling of regulatory requirements.
* Point person for supporting Business and support function coordination pertaining to Enterprise risk management and applicable regulatory frameworks. Supporting compliance with risk management related regulatory guidelines and BASEL requirements.
* Country Operational Risk oversight role including responsibilities guidance and support to local team, RCSA design, sample testing and monitoring implementation, bridging between ORM\- HO and Branch, escalation to HO ORM, trainings etc.
* Oversee Bahrain credit bureau related review, support and follow up for issue resolutions.
* Oversee Mashreq Bahrain risk indicators implementation and support audit readiness. Keep the Risk Committee/ Designated Committee(s) and Senior Management apprised of the assumptions used in and potential shortcomings of the Bank risk models and analysis.
* Ensure that:



 i. Risk reporting to the Risk Committee/ Designated Committee(s) is carefully designed to convey bank\-wide, individual portfolio and other risks in a concise and meaningful manner for designated areas in accordance with HO Risk guidelines/ policies. While reporting, must accurately communicate risk exposures and results of stress tests or scenario analyses and must provoke a robust discussion.
 



 ii. Material risk\-related ad\-hoc information that requires immediate decisions or reactions is promptly presented to Senior Management/ HO Risk and, as appropriate, the Risk Committee/ Designated Committee(s), the responsible officers and, where applicable, the Heads of Control Functions so that suitable measures and activities can be initiated at an early stage
 



**ESG Coordinator** 



* Focal point of coordination for ESG related matters for branches supporting central ESG team for associated regulatory submissions and disclosures for home and host countries.
* Training and awareness for first line of defense to ensure ESG and climate risk related data integration coordination with central function for branches including but not limited to Obligors, third parties, suppliers etc.
* Liaising on climate risk related initiatives for the branches with relevant central teams.
* Supporting central function in formulation of ESG including but not limited to climate risk related policy and procedural aspects for branches.
* Implementation support of ESG, sustainable finance and climate risk related solutions and systems for branches.
* Participation in overall ESG governance as applicable/ Responsible to cover relevant requirements in line CBB ESG Module (CBB Rulebook – Common Volume)
* Second Line of Defense responsibility for ESG risk and relevant ESG regulations across home and host countries, including alignment with Group frameworks



  





 Knowlege,Skills and Experience
 



  




* At least fifteen years of risk management experience, out of which minimum of five years should be in related areas
* Good knowledge of International and Bahrain Regulatory environment
* Expertise with ESG and Climate Risk frameworks
* Strong analytical skills and knowledge on Financial Risk Management
* Professional Risk management Qualification incl. Professional Certification would be a distinct advantage e.g. CFA / FRM/ IRM/ PRM/ SCR (Sustainability \& Climate Risk)
* Excellent computer skills (especially MS office, PPT \& Excel)



 Team player, self\-starter, innovative and highly motivated.

**About Us:** 




 Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an IT services, consulting and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world’s largest businesses in their transformation journeys for over 50 years. TCS offers a consulting\-led, cognitive powered, integrated portfolio of business, technology and engineering services and solutions. This is delivered through its unique Location Independent Agile™ delivery model, recognized as a benchmark of excellence in software development.
 



 A part of the Tata group, India's largest multinational business group, TCS has over 616,171 of the world’s best\-trained consultants with 157 nationalities in 53 countries. For more information, visit www.tcs.com and follow TCS news at @TCS\_News.
 



  





**Job Description:**




  





 An L1 (Level 1\) Back Office (BO) Support Agent provides initial administrative, technical, or operational support to ensure smooth business functioning. They serve as a "behind\-the\-scenes" frontline agent, processing data, resolving routine requests, and escalating complex issues to L2 support, acting as a bridge between internal teams and client\-facing staff.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 · Ticket Management: Receive, log, acknowledge, and classify incoming requests, incidents, or alerts via email, chat, or ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Remedy).
 



 · Data Processing \& Entry: Enter, update, and maintain accurate records in databases, CRM systems, or ERP software.
 



 · Routine Troubleshooting: Provide first\-line fixes for basic issues such as password resets, account unlocking, software installation, or routine IT application support.
 



 · Documentation \& Reporting: Prepare daily/weekly reports on operational metrics, process documentation (e.g., invoices, bills of lading), and maintain accurate filing systems.
 



 · Escalation: Route complex or unresolved problems to L2/L3 technical teams or managers.
 



 · Vendor/Internal Coordination: Coordinate with internal departments or external vendors to process orders, manage inventory, or request support.
 



 · System Monitoring: Monitor application health or server alerts to identify potential bottlenecks or failures.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




  





 · Technical Proficiency: Strong knowledge of MS Office Suite (especially Excel—Pivot Tables, VLookup), and familiarity with CRM or ERP tools.
 



 · Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for updating stakeholders and documenting issues.
 



 · Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to data entry to prevent costly errors.
 



 · Time Management: Ability to work under tight deadlines and prioritize tasks effectively.
 



 · Education: Typically requires a high school diploma or a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, IT, or a related field.
 



 Common Roles \& Contexts
 



 · IT Service Desk L1: Remote troubleshooting, Active Directory management, O365 support.
 



 · BO Executive (Finance/HR): Managing employee records, invoicing, and payroll data.
 



 · Operational Support: Order management, tracking deliveries, and vendor coordination.
 



  





**Application Deadline: 20\-June\-2026** 




  





**Privacy Note:** 




 https://www.tcs.com/connect\-with\-tcs/privacy\-policy

**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
 If you’re looking to unlock new job opportunities, take a look at the possibilities right on your doorstep here at HSBC.
   

  

 HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) is a markets\-led, financing\-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long\-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a high calibre professional to join our team as Head of Global Network Banking in Oman who will have the responsibility to grow the Global Network Banking business in a highly competitive banking environment and ensure HSBC is positioned as the leading international bank for Corporates.
   

  

**Role**
 The job holder will report into the Head of Global Network Banking MENAT on a functional basis and Head of Banking Oman on an entity basis. To be successful in this role, you will:
   

  

* Manage the Global Network Banking (‘GNB’) business supporting international subsidiaries
* Manage a portfolio of clients, driving revenue growth and profitability through proactive relationship management, strategic engagement and close collaboration with risk, product partners and global relationship managers.
* Motivate and lead the GNB team/s, providing both strategic and day\-to\-day direction and guidance across all aspects. Lead the team to acquire and grow appropriate relationships and satisfy transactional and funding needs of international clients
* Create a clear succession and development plan process through identifying and developing talent
* Maximize revenue and customer value at a portfolio and individual relationship level including seamless account opening and credit approval processes
* Formulate and drive business and product strategies to acquire new\-to\-bank business, deepen wallet share and retain existing clients. Develop, implement and monitor the Country management plan, communicating it effectively to all employees with clear expectations and objectives
* Responsible for driving a client\-centric culture within the organization through regular client engagement and dealing with complaints and issues as required
* Assist clients in drawing on the HSBC group network by working closely with other CIB countries and product groups including GTS, GPS and MSS
* Ensure HSBC delivers customer experience and appropriate products and services which understand, meet and exceed customer needs as well as deliver fair outcomes
* Ensure healthy growth of client base through proactive client engagement and connectivity with the corporate network and achieve the Group’s strategy of growing revenues and returns through needs\-based sales
* Ensure that the quality of the lending book meets group’s standards, safeguard the Bank from potential loss, maintain group credit standards, uphold portfolio quality, maintain high level of compliance, and minimize operational and credit banking risks
* Be responsible for shaping and leading cross line of business collaboration, cross\-selling of Group capabilities to ensure that Banking customers can avail themselves of all appropriate services
* Actively engaging in external events, activities and forums that provide opportunity to build HSBC’s brand among the target customer group
* Understand current economic trends and their impact on HSBC in the Country; identify key levers to capitalize on opportunities and/or minimize downside exposure
* Contribute to the long\-term strategic vision and international direction for CIB and identify the key steps necessary for Country alignment and support in achievement of the country, regional and global strategy
* Enhance the Bank’s image in the marketplace and build key relationships with third parties such as investment development boards and Chambers of Commerce
* Set the tone and agenda on Global Standards and all elements of Risk and Compliance as applicable to the role
* Work closely with marketing to devise and implement strategies to enhance brand awareness and equity in the Country


 To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
   

  

* Proven track record of banking experience dealing with international corporate clients
* Strong banking experience in a senior role with exposure to corporate lending, credit structures, risk assessment, cash and payment solutions and trade finance. Banking Experience in/across other geographies is a plus
* Experience managing international subsidiaries and multinational clients in Oman preferred
* Knowledge of banking regulatory framework in Oman
* Strong understanding of Oman’s economy and growth trajectory to develop and align business strategy
* Proven leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire a team towards achieving common goals, and manage a multicultural team
* A passionate client advocate with deep understanding of corporate and institutional client needs, with a demonstrable track record in delivering customer excellence on a global basis for CIB category clients
* Good level of business acumen and commercial awareness, including economic, cultural, procedural and regulatory issues
* Strong credit assessment skills, particularly with regards to more complex and structured facilities
* Proven strategic thinker with a track record in developing and implementing market leading strategies
* Ability to implement strategies, originate business and deliver effective client solutions across investment banking, financing, Markets and flow products
* Ability to interact and build trust and credibility with relationships at all levels of seniority including internal and external stakeholders, ‘C suite’, owner/proprietor client representatives, regulators and government bodies.
* Cross cultural sensitivity and a dynamic personality to constructively engage with multicultural stakeholders (both internal and external)
* Capacity to think about the wider HSBC Group business – to take a Global view
* Graduation degree is a must – to secure a Visa and Work Permit


 You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
   

  

 Issued by The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited.

Lead Product Manager – SaaS Work Management Platform
 



  





 Our client is an Oman\-based technology company developing a cloud\-native work management SaaS platform that helps organisations structure work, manage information, and collaborate more effectively.
 



  





 The platform is designed to be flexible and scalable, supporting a broad range of operational use cases—from simple task coordination to complex, multi\-team workflows. Built fully in\-house, the product places a strong emphasis on usability, configurability, and rapid iteration driven by real user feedback.
 



  





 As an early\-stage product company, the business values ownership, practical problem\-solving, and individuals who enjoy transforming complex requirements into simple, intuitive systems.
 



  





 The Role
 



 Our client is seeking a
 **Lead Product Manager** 
 to take ownership of product design, product discovery, and ongoing product delivery for their SaaS platform.
 



 This role requires a deep understanding of highly configurable, low\-code or no\-code products and how they are used in real\-world environments. The successful candidate will define product behaviour from a user perspective and work closely with engineering and design teams to deliver high\-quality features through frequent release cycles.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership role with significant influence over product direction, usability, and overall quality.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Own end\-to\-end product design from concept through release and continuous improvement
* Lead product discovery and translate user needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Design flexible models for structuring work, data, automation, permissions, and collaboration
* Define and manage the product roadmap, balancing usability, scalability, and delivery speed
* Partner closely with engineering teams to support agile development and frequent releases
* Own product testing, including hands\-on user acceptance testing and feedback\-driven refinement
* Ensure the product is intuitive, coherent, and effective in real operational environments
* Support early go\-to\-market activities, including onboarding flows, documentation, and product positioning
* Act as the internal authority on product behaviour, edge cases, and configuration patterns



  





 Essential Experience \& Skills
 


* Proven experience as a Product Manager working on a SaaS platform
* Hands\-on experience with low\-code, no\-code, or highly configurable platforms
* Strong understanding of how configurable SaaS products are designed, adopted, and misused by real teams
* Excellent judgement around usability, workflow design, and permission models
* Ability to translate ambiguous or evolving requirements into structured product behaviour
* Comfortable leading product decisions in fast\-moving environments with changing priorities



  





 Nice to Have
 


* Experience with B2B SaaS products serving SMEs or mid\-market organisations
* Experience taking products from early development through launch and iteration
* Exposure to operationally complex or compliance\-driven business environments



  





 Why Apply
 


* Opportunity to lead a product from its early foundations
* High level of ownership over how the platform works and feels
* Close collaboration with engineering teams and senior stakeholders
* Fast feedback loops and frequent production releases
* Chance to build a product with real impact in a growing market



  





 Location
 



 The role is based in
 **Oman** 
 . Relocation or regional experience is welcomed, and working arrangements can be discussed for the right candidate.
 



  





 How to Apply
 



 If you have experience building or shaping configurable SaaS products and enjoy turning complexity into elegant, usable systems, we would be keen to hear from you.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**The mission**
 We believe the transformative potential of AI is significantly under\-realised in our region. To bridge this gap, we are incubating a new division within Careem dedicated to Enterprise AI Transformation.
   

  

 We are reimagining and building the future of work to simplify and improve how businesses function in the era of GenAI with WorkOS: a next\-generation ‘operating system’ designed to deploy, orchestrate, and improve AI agents across every customer and operational journey (and increasingly autonomously). This isn’t just automation; it’s about creating a hybrid workforce where self\-learning AI agents handle the heavy lifting, empowering our people to focus on the highest\-value, most creative work.
   

  

**The team**
 This group operates as a
 **startup within Careem** 
 with a distinct mandate: move fast, build boldly, and deliver production\-grade AI systems that fundamentally change how the region leverages technology.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a
 **Founding Forward Deployed Engineer \- WorkOS \- Enterprise Agentic AI** 
 to be the vanguard of the WorkOS mission. This is a role for a "heretic": someone who cares more about solving the problem and delivering value than following a rigid spec. You will be the bridge between our core AI engine and the messy, high\-stakes reality of our customers’ operations.
   

  

 As an FDE, you arent sitting in the back office; you are on the front lines, embedded with internal Careem verticals and external enterprise partners. In partnership with your implementation squad, consisting also of business transformation consultants, you will identify their deepest friction points and build the "special ops" code that proves the power of WorkOS. Your work is the proof of concept that will redefine how the region works.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Tip of the Spear: Lead the deployment of WorkOS in the field. You will be responsible for understanding a customers operational "chaos" and architecting an AI\-driven solution that fixes it in weeks, not months.
* Rapid\-Fire Execution: Build, iterate, and ship. You will write high\-quality, full\-stack code to create bespoke integrations and augment our platform’s core capabilities and create custom agents. This goes beyond context engineering; you’ll build the connective tissue \- integrating bespoke APIs, setting up RAGs and Evals, tuning the E2E system and performance, and architecting multi\-agent handoffs.
* Feedback Loop Mastery: You are the eyes and ears of the product team. You will translate field\-tested insights into core product requirements, ensuring WorkOS remains grounded in real\-world utility.
* Winning Stakeholders: Act as the technical face of WorkOS. You’ll need to win the trust of stakeholders, navigate complex enterprise hierarchies, and persuade skeptics by shipping results that speak for themselves.
* Technical Versatility: One day you’re setting up a RAG pipeline; the next, you’re debugging a legacy enterprise API or designing a custom dashboard. You do whatever is necessary to make the solution land.


**What You’ll Need**
* 5–8\+ years of high\-octane engineering experience. You are likely a senior\-level engineer who is "hungrier" than your peers and bored by traditional, slow\-moving dev cycles.
* The FDE Pedigree: Experience in forward\-deployed, mission\-driven environments (e.g., Palantir, high\-growth startups, or specialized consultancy) where you worked directly with customers.
* Full\-Stack Polyglot: Mastery of the modern stack (React/TS, Python/Node) with the ability to jump into any codebase and be productive on day one.
* AI Fluidity: Strong working knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks. You dont just know the theory; you know how to make AI work in production.
* Excellent Communication: You are a "social engineer." You can explain complex AI logic to a CEO and then pivot to a deep\-dive session with an infrastructure lead without missing a beat.
* Relentless Bias for Action: You are a builder who values shipping over perfection. You have a "founder\-level" sense of ownership and arent afraid to get your hands dirty.
* Willingness to work on\-site full time in UAE, with occasional travel to be embedded with regional partners.


**What You’ll Receive**
* A Blank Canvas and Live Ammunition: The rare opportunity to build a "0\-to\-1" product while immediately deploying it into the real\-world operations of a regional giant. No "sandbox" projects here, you’ll be shipping code that moves people and goods on day one. This is a huge opportunity to create impact in our region.
* A Special Ops Mission: We’re a lean, impact\-obsessed team operating with total autonomy. You’ll be free from corporate bureaucracy and legacy baggage, focused entirely on winning the customer and solving "unsolvable" problems.
* Direct Collaboration with Leadership: Direct engagement with Careem and enterprise client leadership, in addition to working side\-by\-side with the WorkOS founding team including Magnus Olsson (Careem’s original Co\-founder).
* Competitive Compensation: Including direct equity in this new division. Our philosophy is meritocratic: we want you to own a meaningful stake in the value you create.


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We Offer Colleagues The Opportunity To Drive Impact In The Region While They Learn And Grow. As a Full Time Careem Colleague, You Will Be Able To
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.


 Job Details
   

  

 Role Level: Not Applicable Work Type: Full\-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: http://www.careem.com Job Function: Engineering Company Industry/
   

  

 Sector: Technology Information and Internet and IT Services and IT Consulting
   

  

 What We Offer

 Searching, interviewing and hiring are all part of the professional life. The TALENTMATE Portal idea is to fill and help professionals doing one of them by bringing together the requisites under One Roof. Whether you're hunting for your Next Job Opportunity or Looking for Potential Employers, we're here to lend you a Helping Hand.

 So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry\-changing team.

 As Head of IT, you will own and improve the company’s corporate IT environment so employees can work securely, efficiently, and with minimal friction. You will lead internal IT operations across service management, workplace technology, user access, equipment lifecycle, vendor management, and AI enablement for internal functions. Your role is to ensure core IT services are reliable, scalable, and well governed, while balancing user experience, security, innovation, and cost. You will work closely with People, Security, Finance, Legal, and department leads to support onboarding, offboarding, access control, procurement, and day\-to\-day IT operations across a global organisation. You will also drive adoption of AI tools that improve productivity and workflows, while establishing clear guardrails for secure, compliant, and responsible use. This role is hands\-on in execution, while also responsible for building structure, standards, and a long\-term roadmap for the internal IT landscape.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the internal IT service management setup, including request handling, incident management, prioritisation, and SLA tracking
* Ensure employees receive timely, high\-quality support for workplace technology and access\-related needs
* Define and improve support processes, service catalogues, and internal documentation
* Monitor service performance and drive continuous improvement based on trends and feedback
* Own the corporate IT landscape, including end\-user tools, identity and access setup, collaboration systems, and workplace technology
* Maintain a clear roadmap for tool standardization, lifecycle management, and process automation
* Ensure core internal systems are reliable, secure, and fit for business needs
* Oversee procurement, provisioning, tracking, and lifecycle management of company devices and related equipment
* Ensure smooth onboarding, role changes, and offboarding through effective equipment and access processes
* Maintain accurate IT asset inventory and clear ownership records
* Define hardware standards and replacement cycles aligned with operational and budget needs
* Manage relationships with IT vendors and service providers, including selection, renewals, performance reviews, and issue escalation
* Support IT budget planning, cost control, and license optimisation across the corporate IT stack
* Drive adoption of approved AI tools and automation solutions that improve productivity, service quality, and operational efficiency
* Establish guardrails for AI usage, including tool approval criteria, data handling standards, access controls, and coordination with Security, Legal, and relevant stakeholders
* Lead and develop the corporate IT function, including prioritisation, workload planning, and capability building
* Partner with People, Finance, Legal, Security, and department leaders on company\-wide IT needs
* Translate business requirements into practical IT solutions, standards, and implementation plans


**Job Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience in corporate IT, internal IT, workplace technology, or IT operations roles, including leadership responsibility
* Proven experience owning or scaling IT service management and internal support operations in a growing technology company
* Strong understanding of identity and access management, endpoint lifecycle management, SaaS administration, and collaboration tools
* Experience with IT asset management, procurement processes, and vendor management
* Track record of improving IT processes, documentation, automation, and service quality
* Practical experience evaluating, rolling out, or governing AI tools for internal productivity or operational use cases
* Ability to define pragmatic guardrails for AI adoption, including security, access, compliance, and acceptable use considerations
* Ability to balance user experience, security, operational reliability, innovation, and cost efficiency
* Experience working cross\-functionally with People, Finance, Legal, Security, and business stakeholders
* Hands\-on, pragmatic mindset with the ability to switch between strategic planning and operational execution


**Nice\-to\-Haves**
* Experience in Web3, crypto, or other fast\-scaling international technology environments
* Familiarity with MDM, SSO, device compliance, and zero\-touch provisioning practices
* Experience implementing or improving ITIL\-based service management processes
* Exposure to audit, compliance, or policy\-driven IT control environments
* Experience with automation for onboarding, access management, or IT support workflows


**Why work for us?**
* Join a young, creative team in a fast\-paced and supportive environment
* We’re open to new ideas — if you’ve got a vision, pitch it and make it happen
* Enjoy competitive pay that matches your skills and experience
* Be part of a company that’s shaping the future of DeFi
* Take time when you need it — we offer unlimited vacation days
* Get fully compensated for your work gear — we’ll set you up for success


*1inch is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to evaluating all candidates on the basis of their skills, experience, and potential — regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe diverse teams build better products, and we welcome applications from all backgrounds.*
 We use AI\-assisted tools to help us review applications efficiently. These tools support our recruitment team but do not make decisions on our behalf — every application is reviewed by a person before any outcome is determined. No offer or rejection is made solely on the basis of automated processing.
